Job Opening: Engineering Manager

We are pleased to announce a new opportunity for a skilled and proactive Engineering Manager to join our team at BCD TripTech. If you are passionate about leading multiple teams, driving technical direction, and fostering a culture of high performance, we invite you to consider this role.

What you will be doing:

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with Team Leads to coach and mentor them.

  • Fostering a culture of high performance across all teams and proactively identifying opportunities to improve departmental effectiveness.

  • Maintaining a deep understanding of your teams’ systems and how they fit into the broader product and architectural ecosystem.

  • Driving professional growth initiatives across your department.

  • Partnering with Product Managers to ensure teams are building the right things and focusing on top priorities.

  • Understanding short- and long-term product strategies and adjusting plans accordingly.

  • Overseeing planning, estimation, and timely delivery of key technical initiatives.

  • Collaborating with Upper Leadership and other Engineering Managers to align efforts and escalate issues when needed.

  • Acting as a communication bridge between teams, stakeholders, and leadership.

You certainly:

  • Have 5+ years of proven experience as an Engineering Manager or in a similar leadership role in a technical environment, on top of the previous engineering background.

  • Possess a strong background in software engineering with the ability to understand system architecture.

  • Demonstrate the ability to manage multiple teams or projects simultaneously.

  • Are hands-on with logging, monitoring, QA, and deployment processes.

  • Have deep experience in mentoring, team-building, and performance management.

  • Communicate fluently in English (Upper-Intermediate/Advanced level).

  • Can be located anywhere in Europe or the US East Coast timezone.

You probably:

  • Have prior experience in the business travel domain.

  • Have led cross-functional distributed teams across multiple regions.

  • Are comfortable balancing strategic goals with operational excellence.

Who we are:

We are a tech team of adventurous travellers, once a part of Y Combinator alumni — GetGoing Inc, founded in 2012 by Harvard, Stanford, and Berkeley graduates. We raised ~$10M in venture capital from Silicon Valley and, in 2016, joined BCD Travel (), a global corporate travel management company with annual sales of $25 billion, to bring our unique hotel booking technology into BCD’s products.

What we do:

We develop a B2B booking platform for business trips, which helps users book hotels, flights, and cars. It provides both business travellers and their travel agents with detailed itineraries and the best booking options. Every day, thousands of business travellers across the world use our software built on modern technology.

We use:

  • Frontend: ES6, React/Redux.

  • Backend: Python 3 and Clojure, plus Django, DRF, Celery, Gevent, aiohttp, Airflow.

  • Databases & infrastructure: PostgreSQL, Redis, Memcached, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, Terraform, Ansible, StackStorm, Splunk, Docker.

  • Everything runs on AWS.

What we offer:

  • A results-oriented startup mindset with a stable business model backed by a billion-dollar global travel company.

  • Competitive compensation and medical insurance.

  • Conferences, workshops, and certifications refund.

  • A friendly, professional, and high-skilled team working with the newest technologies.

  • Flexible hours and the ability to choose between full-time remote, partly remote, or office work.

  • A great office location in the very center of Kyiv near metro stations Zoloti Vorota / Teatralna / Khreschatyk (we have an extra “coffee” kitchen for coffee geeks, a game zone with a kicker, a bomb shelter in the building, and 2 independent electricity lines to make the workday more stable).

  • 25 working days of vacation + 6 covered sick days.

raw.description:
STARLIMS Corporation is a private equity-backed, high-growth technology company scaling its financial planning and reporting infrastructure to support the next phase of growth.

We are hiring an FP&A Manager to own financial planning, reporting, and systems architecture for the business, with a particular focus on managing and scaling our Workday Adaptive Planning environment. This role sits at the intersection of financial analysis and systems ownership — ideal for a finance professional who has led an Adaptive implementation (or owns one today) and wants to bring that expertise to a metrics-driven, PE-backed business. You'll partner directly with the C-suite and cross-functional leaders on budgeting, forecasting, and board/investor reporting, while serving as the internal expert on our financial planning tech stack.

Responsibilities:

Systems Ownership & Architecture

  • Own and administer the Workday Adaptive Planning environment, including model structure, data integrations, and ongoing system maintenance.
  • Manage all data flows into and out of Adaptive, ensuring accuracy and integrity across connected systems (ERP, CRM, data warehouse).
  • Build and maintain automated, consolidated financial reporting files that refresh reliably for monthly SLT, Board, and investor review.
  • Continuously evaluate and scale the planning tool as the business grows — new modules, workflows, and integrations.
Financial Planning & Analysis:
  • Manage expense budgeting and full P&L reporting across the business, partnering with executive leadership to forecast bookings, revenue, labor, and EBITDA performance.
  • Drive ACV and ARR-based forecasting and performance analysis — evaluating bookings, expansion, churn, and net revenue retention to inform growth strategy.
  • Deliver monthly, quarterly, and annual forecasts and variance analysis to senior leadership.
  • Support the annual operating planning process end-to-end.

Business Partnership:

  • Serve as a trusted financial advisor to department and functional leaders, translating financial data into clear, actionable narratives.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve the speed and accuracy of financial analysis, including leveraging AI/automation tools where applicable.
  • Present financial results and insights directly to executive leadership.

What Success Looks Like:

In your first 0–6 months, success looks like:

  • We are leveraging a 3rd party to assist with the Workday Adaptive Planning environment with clean data flows from SFDC and Netsuite and documented processes.
  • Monthly, quarterly, and Board/investor reporting packages are produced on an automated, reliable cadence the CFO and executive team trust.
  • ACV/ARR, bookings, churn, and NRR forecasting is integrated into the planning model and actively used to inform growth strategy discussions.
  • Functional leaders across the business view you as a go-to financial partner, not just a reporting function.

Requirements:

Required

  • 3–5+ years of progressive FP&A experience, ideally within a SaaS, subscription, or PE-backed business.
  • Direct, hands-on experience implementing and/or administering Workday Adaptive Planning — this is a must-have, not a nice-to-have; candidates should be able to speak to model design, system data flows, and ongoing ownership, not just report consumption.
  • Demonstrated experience with ACV/ARR/SaaS metrics (bookings, churn, NRR, expansion revenue) and full P&L or expense-vertical ownership.
  • Track record of building scalable reporting infrastructure — e.g., consolidating multi-entity financials into automated, board-ready reporting packages.
  • Strong financial modeling and forecasting skills; comfort working directly with C-suite stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field required.
  • Self-starter mindset with a bias toward automation, process improvement, and continuous learning.

Preferred

  • Advanced certifications (e.g., HBS Finance & Accounting certificate) a plus.
  • Experience with additional financial systems (e.g., OfficeConnect, NetSuite, Salesforce) and BI/visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Prior progression through a structured financial development or rotational program.
  • Experience navigating a fast-growth or PE-backed environment.
STARLIMS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, religion, color, national or ethnic origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, genetic information, veteran status, age or disability status.

raw.description:
Jumpseller is a SaaS solution for small business to manage their online business. We focus on making e-commerce easier for everyone, so businesses can focus on what they do best: building and selling their products. Today, merchants use the Jumpseller platform to manage every aspect of their online business — from products to orders to customers, selling with an online store, on mobile, on social networks and through different e-commerce channels.

At Jumpseller you will find a startup environment in which your contributions matter and you are enabled to grow professionally. We have 2 offices, one in Porto, Portugal, and another in Santiago, Chile, and our working culture is international. We all work fully remote.

The role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our growing team. We look for skilled & dedicated people who share our passion for building a product that millions of people use.

You will

  • Work in an informal environment, for a global market;

  • Strive to write clean, modular, flawless and scalable code responsible to handle millions of records;

  • Design new features from ground-up, from a given set of specs;

  • Build automated tests for your code while help improving and maintaining our current test set;

  • Be in contact with our Customer Support Team, resolving technical issues and understand how to improve our service;

  • Take responsibility, autonomy and ownership of your work.

Your Day

Some projects and activities that we have been recently working on to give you a sense of what you’ll be doing day-to-day.

  • Work along a team of developers, designers and product owners to build a Multi-location Inventory;

  • Help complete one of our recurrent Meta Security Assessments;

  • Create an Import / Export tool, in CSV, to quickly manage stock;

  • Implement a bar code scan in React Native, for our Mobile App;

  • Work closely with our Design Team and set up the infrastructure for our UI Design System;

  • Spend a day working directly with our client-based and Support Team, triaging and fixing production issues;

  • Model in UML a new database structure for our upcoming Gift Cards feature.


The Recruitment Process

  • We will review all the CVs & Cover Letters received;

  • First interviews - lasting 30 minutes. This is an introductory meeting with our People Department, so that you get to know Jumpseller and present yourself;

  • Top candidates will be invited to participate in a Case Study, which will be done at their own pace and should not take over 4hs. Not more than 4 to 6 invitations will be sent.

  • Finally, a last interview - lasting 45 to 60 minutes - to review the resolution Case Study & focus deeper on your main professional project/achievement;

  • We expect to send you an offer by July.

All candidates will be notified from us once the process is concluded. Those on the last interview stage can request brief feedback about their application.

Requirements

You are

  • A bachelor/master in Informatics (or related);

  • Proven professional experience in OO programming and web development;

  • Attentive to details, delivering quality code which is maintainable, efficient and reliable;

  • Experienced in MySQL, or other relational databases;

  • Familiar with version-control and automated testing tools;

  • Used to work in JSON/XML/CSV formats and have no issues with HTML/CSS;

  • Experienced in Ruby or Ruby and Rails (the right candidate will be considered without this experience);

  • Good in English communication and teamwork.

IT-Spezialist / Softwareentwickler (m/w/d)

Teil- oder Vollzeit · 30 bis 40 Stunden pro Woche · Remote / Homeoffice

Du möchtest nicht einfach nur bestehende Systeme verwalten, sondern aktiv an neuen digitalen Lösungen arbeiten?

Du begeisterst Dich für Softwareentwicklung, Automatisierungen und künstliche Intelligenz und möchtest Deine Ideen in einem wachsenden Unternehmen direkt in die Praxis umsetzen?

Dann werde Teil unseres IT-Teams.

Bei Tunymedia übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Software, digitalen Prozesse und technischen Infrastruktur. Du entwickelst Automatisierungen, begleitest IT-Projekte und arbeitest gemeinsam mit uns daran, neue KI-Lösungen und digitale Produkte aufzubauen. Dabei bist Du nicht nur Ansprechpartner für technische Fragen, sondern vor allem Mitgestalter unserer zukünftigen Systeme und Prozesse.

Das erwartet Dich bei uns:

➡️ Du entwickelst unsere Software aktiv weiter:
Du arbeitest an bestehenden Anwendungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns neue Funktionen, Systeme und digitale Lösungen.

➡️ Du automatisierst Prozesse:
Du erkennst wiederkehrende und ineffiziente Abläufe und entwickelst technische Lösungen, mit denen wir Prozesse schneller, einfacher und skalierbarer gestalten.

➡️ Du arbeitest an innovativen KI-Projekten:
Du beschäftigst Dich mit aktuellen KI-Technologien und prüfst, wie wir künstliche Intelligenz sinnvoll in unsere Software, Prozesse und Dienstleistungen integrieren können.

➡️ Du übernimmst Verantwortung für IT-Projekte:
Du planst und koordinierst technische Projekte, behältst Aufgaben und Abhängigkeiten im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass Lösungen zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.

➡️ Du bist technischer Sparringspartner für unser Team:
Bei internen IT-Fragen unterstützt Du Deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen lösungsorientiert und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme im Arbeitsalltag zuverlässig funktionieren.

➡️ Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen:
Bei uns musst Du nicht auf lange Freigabeprozesse warten. Gute Ideen können schnell besprochen, getestet und umgesetzt werden.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung interner Softwarelösungen

  • Entwicklung und Wartung von Software-Automatisierungen

  • Analyse und Optimierung bestehender digitaler Prozesse

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung neuer KI-Projekte

  • Planung, Koordination und Management von IT-Projekten

  • Wartung und Support bestehender Softwareprojekte

  • Technische Unterstützung bei internen IT-Fragen

  • Bewertung und Einführung neuer Tools, Technologien und Systeme

  • Dokumentation von Anwendungen, Prozessen und technischen Lösungen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und den verschiedenen Fachbereichen

Freue dich auf:

Klarer Einschulungsprozess: Du erhältst einen strukturierten und effizienten Einschulungsplan sowie eine persönliche Begleitung. So lernst Du unsere Systeme, Prozesse und Anforderungen schnell kennen und kannst früh Verantwortung übernehmen.

Klare Arbeitsabläufe: Durch verständliche Anleitungen, Dokumentationen und definierte Prozesse weißt Du, woran Du arbeitest und welche Ziele erreicht werden sollen. Gleichzeitig hast Du den Freiraum, bestehende Abläufe zu hinterfragen und technisch zu verbessern.

Echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten: Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf die Entwicklung unseres Unternehmens. Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen, technische Entscheidungen mitgestalten und Lösungen entwickeln, die von unserem gesamten Team genutzt werden.

Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Du erhältst eigene Verantwortungsbereiche und die Möglichkeit, Projekte selbstständig voranzutreiben. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit den relevanten Ansprechpartnern im Unternehmen zusammen.

Kurze Entscheidungswege: Wir arbeiten pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert. Entscheidungen können schnell getroffen und neue Ideen zeitnah getestet werden.

Langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Mit dem Wachstum unseres Unternehmens entwickeln sich auch Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortungsbereiche weiter. Du hast die Möglichkeit, Dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und langfristig eine zentrale Rolle in unserem IT-Bereich einzunehmen.

Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Die Nachfrage nach digitalen Lösungen, Automatisierungen und KI-Anwendungen wächst kontinuierlich. Als etablierte Digitalisierungsagentur bieten wir Dir einen langfristigen Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Umfeld.

Zusammenhalt und Teamevents: Ein offener, ehrlicher und loyaler Umgang ist uns wichtig. Bei regelmäßigen Teamevents, beispielsweise Bowlingabenden oder unserer Weihnachtsfeier, verbringen wir auch außerhalb des Arbeitsalltags gemeinsam Zeit.

Umfangreiches Gesundheitsprogramm: Dazu gehören unter anderem Bikeleasing, ergonomische Arbeitsplätze (z.B. mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen) im Office und regelmäßige Gesundheitsangebote.

Faire Vergütung: Wir wissen dich, deine Erfahrung und deinen Einsatz zu schätzen. Deine Erfahrung, sowie deine Leistung, fließen direkt in deine Vergütung mit ein.

Über uns

Die Tunymedia GmbH zählt mit über 350 Kunden zu den bekanntesten Digitalisierungsagenturen für die Handwerks- und Möbelbranche im gesamten D-A-CH-Raum.

Mit einem Team von über 25 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern unterstützen wir kleine, mittelständische und große Unternehmen dabei, durch Digitalisierung neue Fachkräfte zu gewinnen, mehr Kundenanfragen zu generieren und ihre internen Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten. Zu unseren Kunden zählen zahlreiche Klein- und Mittelbetriebe sowie bekannte Unternehmen wie Schaffrath, Flamme Möbel, WEKO, DAN Küchen, HELLA Sonnenschutz und McDonald’s.

Wir entwickeln uns kontinuierlich weiter und investieren verstärkt in eigene Softwarelösungen, Automatisierungen und künstliche Intelligenz. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die nicht nur bestehende Systeme bedienen, sondern gemeinsam mit uns neue Lösungen entwickeln möchten.

Du möchtest Software nicht nur nutzen, sondern gemeinsam mit uns entwickeln?

Dann bewirb Dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft von Tunymedia.

Requirements

Dein Profil:

  • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung, beispielsweise ein Studium im Bereich Informatik, eine HTL, eine Lehre oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Praktische Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung

  • Großes Interesse an Automatisierungen, künstlicher Intelligenz und neuen Technologien

  • Fähigkeit, technische Anforderungen zu verstehen und in funktionierende Lösungen zu übersetzen

  • Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise

  • Bereitschaft, Dich schnell in neue Systeme, Technologien und Themen einzuarbeiten

  • Freude daran, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung zu übernehmen

  • Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und die Bereitschaft, technische Themen auch für Nicht-Techniker verständlich zu erklären

Berufserfahrung ist von Vorteil. Entscheidend ist für uns jedoch vor allem, dass Du bereits praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mitbringst, technisch schnell verstehst und Dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln möchtest.

Deine Bewerbung:

Du kannst Dich direkt über unsere Karriereseite in weniger als zwei Minuten bewerben.

Ein klassisches Anschreiben ist nicht notwendig. Wir möchten vor allem erfahren, welche Erfahrungen Du in der Softwareentwicklung mitbringst, an welchen Projekten Du bereits gearbeitet hast und welche technischen Themen Dich besonders interessieren.

Aus Effizienzgründen nehmen wir ausschließlich Onlinebewerbungen über unsere Karriereseite entgegen. Bewerbungen per Post, E-Mail oder Telefon können nicht berücksichtigt werden.

Wenn du lieber vor Ort arbeiten möchtest, ist dies ebenfalls möglich.

La figura lavorerà principalmente alla progettazione di DEM, banner digitali e materiali destinati a campagne media, utilizzando Figma come principale strumento di lavoro. Cerchiamo una persona capace di trasformare concept, contenuti e linee guida di brand in soluzioni visive efficaci, coerenti e facilmente declinabili nei diversi canali, formati e dispositivi.

Il tuo lavoro

  • Progettazione di DEM responsive, con layout e declinazioni desktop e mobile.

  • Ideazione e design di banner digitali nei principali formati previsti dai piani media.

  • Realizzazione di layout, proposte creative e adattamenti grafici in Figma.

  • Creazione di sistemi modulari che permettano di declinare in modo rapido e coerente i diversi formati di una campagna.

  • Gestione delle declinazioni dei visual nel rispetto delle linee guida del brand.

  • Ricerca di reference, analisi dei competitor e costruzione di proposte visive coerenti con gli obiettivi di comunicazione.

  • Collaborazione con art director, copywriter, account, sviluppatori e altri professionisti coinvolti nel progetto.

Profilo ricercato

  • Esperienza pregressa in un ruolo analogo, preferibilmente presso agenzie creative, agenzie digitali, centri media o realtà strutturate.

  • Esperienza nella progettazione di DEM, banner digitali e creatività multiformato.

  • Ottima conoscenza dei principi di visual design, tipografia, composizione, gerarchia delle informazioni e progettazione responsive.

  • Capacità di interpretare un piano media e di gestire le diverse declinazioni creative nel rispetto di specifiche tecniche, priorità e scadenze.

  • Autonomia progettuale, attenzione al dettaglio e capacità di collaborare con team multidisciplinari.

Competenze Figma richieste

  • Capacità di creare illustrazioni, icone e infografiche vettoriali.

Candidatura

Saranno prese in considerazione le candidature corredate da:

  • autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali.

Nel portfolio ci piacerebbe vedere soprattutto progetti di DEM, banner, campagne digitali e sistemi di declinazione multiformato, indicando, dove possibile, il ruolo svolto, gli strumenti utilizzati e il livello di autonomia nella realizzazione. Saranno particolarmente apprezzati esempi che mostrino non soltanto il risultato visivo finale, ma anche la qualità organizzativa dei file Figma, l’utilizzo di Auto Layout, componenti, varianti e sistemi modulari.

*********

We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented professional who stays up to date with the latest trends in design and digital communication, and who works as a freelancer (with a VAT number). The role will primarily focus on designing responsive email marketing campaigns (EDMs/DEMs), digital banners, and creative assets for media campaigns, using Figma as the main design tool. We're looking for someone who can transform concepts, content, and brand guidelines into effective, consistent visual solutions that can be easily adapted across different channels, formats, and devices.

Your responsibilities

  • Design responsive email marketing campaigns (EDMs/DEMs), including both desktop and mobile layouts.

  • Conceptualize and design digital banners in the main formats required by media plans.

  • Create layouts, creative proposals, and graphic adaptations in Figma.

  • Build modular design systems that allow campaigns to be quickly and consistently adapted to multiple formats.

  • Organize files, components, and assets for smooth handoff to development teams or publishing platforms.

  • Research references, analyze competitors, and develop visual concepts aligned with communication objectives.

  • Collaborate with art directors, copywriters, account managers, developers, and other project stakeholders.

  • Review creative output to ensure quality, consistency, and adaptability across all required formats.

  • Effectively use Generative AI tools to support research and creative production.

Candidate profile

  • Previous experience in a similar role, preferably within creative agencies, digital agencies, media agencies, or other well-structured organizations.

  • Experience designing responsive email campaigns (EDMs/DEMs), digital banners, and multi-format creative assets.

  • Strong understanding of visual design principles, typography, composition, information hierarchy, and responsive design.

  • Ability to interpret media plans and manage creative adaptations while meeting technical specifications, priorities, and deadlines.

  • Ability to work independently, with strong attention to detail and excellent collaboration skills in multidisciplinary teams.

  • An up-to-date portfolio showcasing relevant examples of email campaigns, digital banners, digital marketing campaigns, or Figma projects.

Required Figma skills

  • Auto Layout: Practical experience creating flexible, scalable layouts and managing responsive behavior for desktop and mobile email campaigns.

  • Components & Variants: Ability to create and manage UI kits, CTAs, modules, and reusable components to efficiently produce banner sets in multiple formats.

  • Styles & Variables: Experience managing shared libraries, variables, color and typography styles, grids, and other elements of a design system.

  • File Organization: Strong attention to page structure, frames, components, and consistent naming conventions for layers and assets.

  • Developer Handoff: Ability to prepare files for development with clear specifications for spacing, dimensions, colors, fonts, and fallback fonts.

  • Prototyping & Collaboration: Proficiency with comments, sharing features, and collaborative workflows to present designs and work effectively with the team.

Required Photoshop skills

Excellent proficiency in Adobe Photoshop is required, particularly for the creation, development, and optimization of visuals for digital banners and advertising campaigns. We're looking for someone who can do more than simply lay out existing assets—they should be capable of conceptualizing and producing the visual creative for banners from scratch. A good working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator is also preferred, particularly for creating and managing vector graphics, icons, illustrations, and infographics.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Ability to create or edit responsive HTML email campaigns.

  • Experience developing animated HTML5 banners.

  • Knowledge of Adobe Animate, Google Web Designer, or similar tools.

  • JavaScript skills applied to digital creative production.

  • Motion design and 2D animation skills.

  • Familiarity with the technical specifications of major advertising platforms.

  • Experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Campaign Manager 360, or Adform.

  • Experience using Generative AI for image creation, visual research, and prompt design.

  • Ability to create vector illustrations, icons, and infographics.

Applications will be considered only if they include:

  • An updated CV.

  • A brief cover letter or introduction.

  • A portfolio (PDF or online).

  • Authorization for the processing of personal data.

In your portfolio, we would especially like to see examples of email campaigns (EDMs/DEMs), digital banners, digital marketing campaigns, and multi-format design systems. Whenever possible, please indicate your role in each project, the tools used, and your level of responsibility throughout the design process.

We particularly appreciate portfolios that showcase not only the final visual outcome but also the quality of Figma file organization, including the use of Auto Layout, components, variants, and modular design systems.

Looking for a Sr Media Buyer/Paid Media Manager. This is a hands-in-the-account role from day one for someone obsessed with what makes an ad account scale profitably, not just spend. You will work hand-in-hand with senior buyers to plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns primarily on Meta, with growing responsibility on AppLovin / Axon.

You NEED experience, and sharp instincts, comfort with BIG numbers, and the drive to get great at this fast.
You'll be building campaigns, reading data, spotting what's working, and learning to make confident scale/kill decisions across a portfolio of fast-growing DTC e-commerce brands.

This is a high-performance environment built for hungry, ambitious people who take real ownership of their accounts and treat client budgets like their own.

You'll be responsible for

  • Building, launching, and managing Meta campaigns (CBO/ABO structures, audiences, placements, creative testing).
  • Supporting and growing into independent buying on AppLovin / Axon.
  • Monitoring daily performance and flagging scaling opportunities, underperformers, and anomalies.
  • Running structured creative and audience tests, and documenting the results.
  • Pulling, organizing, and interpreting performance data to inform decisions, and producing clear weekly client reports.
  • Analyzing creative performance using soft metrics (CTR, CPM, CPC), benchmarking against account averages, and clearly communicating those reads to strategists and clients.
  • Helping maintain clean account hygiene, naming conventions, and tracking.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on paid media experience in DTC environments, either in-house or at marketing agencies working with DTC brands
  • Managed monthly per brand around USD 600k to 1M on ad spend (yes, our clients invest over 25k a day on ad spend; you need to manage BIG numbers)
  • Clear written communication in English.
  • Genuine fluency with Meta Ads Manager — you've built campaigns, not just read about them.
  • Strong numerical sense; comfortable living in spreadsheets and dashboards.

  • Working knowledge of tracking and attribution tools (pixels, CAPI, ClickFlare, GA4, etc.).
  • Comfortable staying responsive when accounts demand it, including the occasional evening or weekend during launches or scaling pushes.
  • Availability during key EST windows to analyze performance and take action (scale, kill, pull back, etc.).

Nice to have

  • Experience with AdManage (strongly preferred).
  • Hands-on time with AppLovin / Axon or other programmatic / native platforms.
  • Basic understanding of creative.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Fully remote, full-time contractor role.
  • Learn direct-response media buying directly from senior operators managing significant spend.
  • Real ownership early—you won't be stuck pulling reports for a year.
  • Work across a diverse roster of scaling, fast-growing DTC brands in fashion, beauty, and lifestyle.
  • A fast-paced team environment that rewards results and fosters growth into a senior media buyer role.

Backend Application Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Backend Application Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer focused on high-throughput platform development to design, build, and operate the foundational platforms and shared services that other engineering teams rely on to deliver their products. This role focuses on building backend platform capabilities — request routing, traffic management, data fan-out, caching layers, asynchronous job execution, and durable event processing — that must handle very high traffic volumes with predictable latency and minimal operational toil. The ideal candidate combines deep distributed systems expertise with strong platform-engineering instincts, values internal developer experience as a first-class concern, and has a track record of leading multi-quarter platform initiatives that meaningfully raise the engineering bar for the organizations they support.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and build internal platform services and shared infrastructure that hundreds of engineers depend on every day, with explicit focus on developer experience and operational ergonomics.
  • Architect high-throughput, latency-sensitive backend platforms capable of sustaining very high request volumes with predictable, well-bounded tail latency.
  • Build durable, replayable event-processing pipelines and asynchronous job execution platforms that other product teams compose to ship features faster.
  • Design and operate caching, rate-limiting, and request-shaping layers that protect upstream systems and enable safe scaling under bursty workloads.
  • Develop platform abstractions, SDKs, and paved-road libraries that codify best practices and let product teams consume capabilities without re-implementing them.
  • Establish robust observability, SLOs, and capacity-planning practices for platform services, raising the operational bar across the organization.
  • Drive multi-region, fault-tolerant, and geo-distributed designs with rigorous attention to availability, durability, and graceful degradation under failure.
  • Lead incident response for high-impact platform issues, conduct blameless post-mortems, and drive durable engineering improvements that prevent recurrence.
  • Define and enforce platform-wide standards around API design, schema evolution, deployment, and backward-compatibility guarantees.
  • Optimize platform performance through careful profiling, data-driven tuning, and algorithmic improvements that move the needle on throughput and cost.
  • Partner with infrastructure, security, and SRE teams to ensure platform services meet enterprise reliability, compliance, and security obligations.
  • Mentor mid-level engineers and lead architectural discussions across teams, helping the broader organization grow in distributed-systems maturity.
  • Produce clear technical design documents, decision records, and operational runbooks that make the platform legible to future maintainers.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging platform technologies, open-source projects, and architectural patterns for strategic adoption.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six or more years of professional backend or platform engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated track record building and operating internal platforms or shared services consumed by multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong, hands-on expertise designing distributed systems with rigorous attention to consistency, availability, latency, and failure-mode behavior.
  • Advanced proficiency in at least one major backend language such as Java, Go, Scala, Rust, or modern C++.
  • Deep understanding of high-throughput messaging, streaming, and event-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka, Pulsar, or NATS.
  • Strong working knowledge of data storage systems across relational, key-value, document, and search workloads.
  • Proven experience leading multi-quarter platform initiatives across teams, including stakeholder management and technical decision-making.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to author crisp technical design documents and present trade-offs clearly.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and shape engineering culture through code review, design review, and onboarding contributions.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms or contributing to internal developer-platform initiatives at scale.
  • Contributions to widely-used open-source platform or infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with control-plane / data-plane patterns, service mesh internals, or workflow-orchestration engines.
  • Experience designing platform APIs with strong backward-compatibility and versioning guarantees.
  • Public technical writing, conference talks, or other community contributions on platform engineering topics.

dein gestaltungsfeld

Als unser:e neue:r Recruiter:in bist Du eigenverantwortlich für die gesamte Aufgabenbandbreite im Recruiting auf internationaler Ebene und der damit verbundenen Experience zuständig. In diesem Zusammenhang gestaltest und optimierst Du regelmäßig unseren gesamten Recruiting Lifecycle zusammen mit Deinen Teamkolleg:innen.

Bei uns gibt es viel zu tun, denn neben der strategischen Beratung der Fachkolleg:innen nimmst Du als Kommunikationstalent ebenfalls das Active Sourcing für unsere Vakanzen unter Deine Fittiche, rekrutierst so neue internationale Talente für unser Team und baust ein Netzwerk für zukünftige Bedarfe auf. Du erarbeitest und optimierst in diesem Zusammenhang immer wieder erfolgversprechende Lösungsansätze durch neue Active Sourcing Strategien und arbeitest eng mit den Kolleg:innen und Führungskräften aus unseren verschiedensten Bereichen zusammen, um eine tolle Candidate Experience für unsere Bewerber:innen zu kreieren.

Neben den täglichen Recruitingaufgaben gibt es aber noch genug Abwechslung durch spannende Projekte, die gemeinsam im Team besprochen, priorisiert und vorantreiben werden. Eine tragende Rolle spielt dabei die Umsetzung unserer erarbeiteten Employer Branding Strategie: Diese liegt uns besonders am Herzen und ist ein essenzieller Baustein unseres Erfolgs, den wir ohne Dich nicht stemmen können. Wir suchen daher jemanden, der unsere Arbeitgebermarke mit Herzblut, Strategie und Weitblick nach außen trägt.

Als Company mit dem Mindset Remote-First, ist es uns sehr wichtig, den persönlichen Kontakt und unser „Teambuilding“ aufrechtzuerhalten. Unsere Tools geben uns die Möglichkeit durch einen „Virtual Coffee“ oder durch ein digitales Teammeeting Zeit miteinander zu verbringen, in der wir bewusst nicht über Arbeitsthemen sprechen. So sind wir bestmöglich aufgestellt und höchst motiviert, auch virtuell zusammenzuarbeiten.

was uns überzeugt

Deine Persönlichkeit, gepaart mit:

  • einer abgeschlossenen Berufsausbildung oder einem Studium im Bereich Personal oder einer vergleichbaren Ausbildung
  • fundierten Wissen rund um alle Recruiting-Themen (insbesondere Active Sourcing) sowie mit relevanter Berufserfahrung im IT-Recruiting
  • Interesse an den neusten Recruiting-Trends – bei uns hast Du die Spielwiese für neue Ideen und Fortschritt
  • einer Vorliebe für selbstständiges, verantwortungsbewusstes und lösungsorientiertes Arbeiten – ohne Deine Mitgestaltung können wir uns nicht weiterentwickeln
  • Spaß an einer offenen Kommunikation und daran auf Menschen zuzugehen
  • sehr guten Englischkenntnissen, da wir auf internationaler Ebene tätig sind

Wir wissen, dass unter Umständen nicht alle Anforderungen auf Dich zutreffen werden. Wenn Du jedoch mit der richtigen Portion Engagement und Begeisterung für die Aufgabe zu uns kommst, können wir gemeinsam viel bewirken.

darauf kannst du zählen

Bei Contabo sind wir stetig in Bewegung. Unser Wachstum eröffnet neue Möglichkeiten, Ideen einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und aktiv mitzugestalten. Hier kommen Menschen zusammen, die Dinge voranbringen.

Was uns dabei ausmacht, sind Vertrauen, direkte Kommunikation und eine offene Feedbackkultur. Wir glauben daran, dass die besten Lösungen gemeinsam entstehen und jede:r die Möglichkeit hat, sich einzubringen, zu lernen und einen eigenen Footprint zu hinterlassen.

Zusätzlich bieten wir Dir:

  • Arbeite, wie es zu Dir passt – Remote oder hybrid mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance sowie mit technischer Ausstattung wie im Büro
  • Erlebe echte Freiheit – Workation im EU-Ausland und in unserem Summer Office auf Mallorca

  • Genieße exklusive Vorteile – Attraktive Konditionen durch unser Corporate-Benefits-Programm bei vielen Produkten und Dienstleistungen
  • Tanke neue Energie – 30 Tage Urlaub sowie zusätzliche freie Tage an Weihnachten und Silvester
  • Engagiere Dich – Ein zusätzlicher freier Tag für soziales Engagement im Rahmen unseres Volunteer Day
  • Gestalte mit und mache einen Unterschied – Große Gestaltungsfreiräume für Deine kreativen Ideen und echten Impact
  • Entwickle Dich weiter – Individuelle berufliche und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem innovativen und technologischen Umfeld
  • Arbeite, wo Du Dich wohlfühlst – Modern eingerichtete und verkehrsgünstig gelegene Büros an unseren europäischen Standorten
  • Werde Teil eines vielfältigen Teams – Arbeite in einem internationalen Umfeld, das von Diversität lebt

Company Overview: 

SAFR  from RealNetworks is a unified ecosystem specializing in face-based computer vision solutions optimized for real-world performance. Building on a legacy of digital media expertise and innovation, RealNetworks has created a new generation of products that employ best-in-class artificial intelligence and machine learning to enhance and secure our daily lives.


Position Overview: 

Location:Remote in the US, West Coast preferred.

SAFR is looking for a results-oriented Senior Demand Generation Manager to build and scale pipeline generation across our retail business. Working closely with Marketing, Sales, SDRs, and executive leadership, you will own the execution of integrated marketing programs that generate qualified pipeline across our target retail segments, from independent retailers to SMB chains to national retailers.

This role is responsible for turning strategy into measurable demand. You will develop and execute campaigns, webinars, account-based marketing (ABM) programs, nurture journeys, and SDR enablement that consistently generate qualified opportunities for our sales organization.

If you thrive on building repeatable pipeline engines, measuring results, continuously optimizing campaigns, and embracing AI to improve marketing performance, we want to hear from you!

What you’ll do:

Pipeline Generation

  • Plan and deliver webinars that educate prospects and generate qualified leads.
  • Develop and execute integrated demand generation campaigns that create qualified pipeline across multiple retail segments.
  • Plan and execute account-based marketing (ABM) programs targeting strategic accounts.
  • Identify and prioritize target accounts in partnership with Sales.
  • Build and manage multi-channel campaigns utilizing email, webinars, digital marketing, partner marketing, events, LinkedIn, and outbound support.
  • Own campaign calendars and execution from planning through measurement.

Marketing Automation

  • Build and optimize marketing automation workflows, lead nurture programs, and campaign reporting.
  • Manage lead routing and campaign attribution within HubSpot.
  • Continuously optimize campaign performance based on conversion metrics and pipeline impact.

Sales & SDR Enablement

  • Partner closely with Marketing to translate messaging into executable campaigns.
  • Provide SDRs and Account Executives with campaign assets, outreach messaging, target account lists, and follow-up programs.
  • Ensure marketing campaigns and SDR outreach are tightly coordinated.
  • Develop repeatable campaign playbooks that improve SDR productivity and meeting conversion.

Measurement & Optimization

  • Measure campaign effectiveness using MQLs, SQLs, pipeline creation, conversion rates, and influenced revenue.
  • Analyze campaign performance and recommend optimizations based on data.
  • Incorporate feedback from SDRs, Sales, and customers to continually improve campaign effectiveness.
  • Manage marketing budgets to maximize pipeline generation and return on investment.

What we are looking for:

  • 5+ years of B2B demand generation experience.
  • Experience building integrated campaigns for SaaS products.
  • AI-native marketer who routinely leverages generative AI tools to accelerate campaign development and improve performance.
  • Demonstrated success generating measurable pipeline through multi-channel marketing programs.
  • Experience with account-based marketing (ABM).
  • Strong experience with HubSpot.
  • Experience partnering closely with SDR and sales organizations.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience measuring campaign ROI and pipeline performance.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Experience marketing to retailers or physical security technology buyers, preferrable

Salary range for this position: $110K-$120K/year plus 10% bonus

RealNetworks is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We participate in E-Verify.

Oracle Cloud Financials Delivery Architect

JOB SUMMARY:

A Delivery Architect at Argano is a highly experienced professional in the consulting family responsible for providing solution leadership to mid to large size client engagements and contributing to the growth and development of the consulting practice. The ideal candidate will be a consummate professional who can thrive in an upbeat and innovative environment and collaborate with clients to deliver a state-of-the-art solution. The individual will excel at delivering high quality service and cutting-edge solutions to Argano clients in the Oracle community. The Oracle Cloud Delivery Architect will focus on guiding and assisting clients through all phases of Oracle ERP Cloud implementation. The Oracle Cloud Delivery Architect is expected to have expertise in implementing a wide range of Oracle Cloud applications. The successful candidate will have completed five successful Oracle Cloud implementations. An Oracle Cloud Delivery Architect is responsible for the overall Enterprise Cloud solution. The Delivery Architect will lead the implementation team in all phases of the implementation. This individual will identify and apply creative and innovative approaches to resolving product implementation and integration obstacles. They provide expert advice, guidance, and solutions related to technology to businesses and organizations. Their goal is to help clients optimize their technology infrastructure, processes, and strategies to achieve their business objectives more efficiently and effectively.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead mid to large size and complex consulting projects simultaneously.
  • Extensive whole lifecycle experience in leading Oracle SaaS requirements workshops, solutions architecture & design discussions
  • Using in-depth knowledge of Oracle Cloud Applications, as well as industry best practice expertise, consults with clients to provide cost effective solutions to client business scenarios.
  • Leads the implementation team in creating the overall Enterprise Cloud solution. This includes both the technical and functional solutions.
  • Experience in extending Oracle SaaS footprints with PaaS extensions. This involves designing solutions and writing specifications to create custom applications and integrating them with Oracle Cloud Applications
  • Analyze current systems and data to identify new requirements, recognizing the need for systems enhancements or modifications if necessary.
  • Ability to Lead, mentor, train and guide an Oracle Cloud applications team.
  • Experience in mapping enterprise requirements to multiple applications in the Oracle SaaS Applications
  • Identifies and applies creative and innovative approaches to resolving product implementation and integration obstacles and problems.
  • Develop and implement long-term client strategies.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients. Effectively communicate with clients, team members, and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Keep all parties informed about project progress, challenges, and changes.
  • Actively engage project stakeholders in the estimation process, mindful of the impact of strategic business changes.
  • Support business partners in presenting solution value to key stakeholders effectively.
  • Collaborate with third-party vendors and suppliers to source necessary hardware, software, or services. Negotiate contracts and agreements to secure the best terms for the client.
  • Present compelling business cases, clearly quantifying the benefits of proposed solutions.
  • Continuously monitor the performance of implemented solutions to identify areas for improvement or optimization. Provide recommendations for updates, upgrades, or modifications as needed.

MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, etc.
  • MBA, relevant master's degree or PhD.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum 10 years of experience as Oracle Functional consultant with 3+ years of experience in solution design for ERP cloud implementations.
  • Expert level experience as an Oracle Cloud Architect implementing or supporting Oracle Cloud implementation projects and upgrades.
  • Experience with Oracle Platform as a Service (PaaS) with a focus on Integration Cloud Service, Database Cloud Service
  • Knowledgeable and experience with Web Services and the use of Oracle Cloud delivered Web Services (SOAP & REST)
  • Expert consulting experience and business analytical skills to gather and document business requirements, leading fit-gap analysis, business process designs, managing conference room pilots (CRPs), perform functional configuration, and manage testing of procurement ERP solutions.
  • Experience in navigating the challenges of working with cross-border and diverse teams and projects.
  • Understanding of corporate month end close and consolidation process and/or planning or forecast management reporting requirements.
  • Expert level experience with one or more of the following Oracle Cloud Applications:
    • Oracle ERP Cloud
    • Oracle Project Portfolio Management Cloud
    • Oracle Supply Chain Management Cloud
    • Oracle Manufacturing Cloud
    • Oracle EPM Cloud
  • Strong consulting experience and business analytical skills to gather and document business requirements, leading fit-gap analysis, business process designs, managing conference room pilots (CRPs), perform functional configuration, and manage testing of ERP solutions.
  • Proven experience with guiding clients through business process improvements
  • Wide range of accounting experiences such as Chart of accounts redesign, proven financial reporting experience and MultiOrg / Mutli Currency experience.
  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills
  • High commitment to exceed performance expectations.
  • Ability to write functional specification based on user requirements.
  • Senior enough to be able to independently handle client expectations.
  • Professional approach when dealing with internal and external customers.
  • Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.
  • Preferred consulting experience in a similar role in a professional services firm or industry experience at a strategic level is required.
  • Previous experience working in IT companies.
  • In-depth knowledge of the technologies and systems relevant.
  • Creating a positive environment by monitoring workloads of the team while meeting client expectations

SKILL REQUIREMENTS

  • Communication: Proficient in English written and verbal communications. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
  • Complex Project Management: Delivery Architects are responsible for leading multiple complex projects, necessitating exceptional project management skills.
  • Thought Leadership: Providing thought leadership and industry expertise is critical in projects.
  • Client Acquisition: They should have strong business development skills to acquire new clients and expand existing relationships.
  • Mentorship and Coaching: Indirectly developing and coaching junior and mid-level consultants is a significant responsibility.
  • Strategic Vision: Delivery Architects should contribute to the firm's strategic vision and decision-making.
  • Executive Presence: The ability to interact effectively with senior client executives is important.

About CurifyLabs

CurifyLabs is pioneering 3D printing solutions for personalized medicine. We partner with compounding pharmacies to streamline production, expand what they can offer, and ultimately improve patient care — making personalized treatments faster, safer, and more accessible to the people who need them.

We’re hiring an

Inside Sales Representative

to power the top of our U.S. sales funnel.

You’ll be the first conversation many private compounding pharmacies have with CurifyLabs — opening doors, qualifying interest, and setting the table for our field reps to close.

This is a high-volume, high-impact role. You’ll spend your days reaching out to pharmacy owners and head pharmacists, having real conversations about their compounding workflows, and figuring out which ones are worth a deeper dive. The strong ones, you hand off warm to our field sales team. The not-yet-ready ones, you nurture until they are.

What You’ll Do

  • Run outbound outreach (calls, email, LinkedIn) to U.S. private compounding pharmacies — owners, head pharmacists, and decision-makers.
  • Timely, qualify inbound leads from marketing campaigns, conferences, shows, and the website, and route them to the right next step.
  • Hold discovery conversations to understand each pharmacy’s setup, ambitions, and bottlenecks.
  • Book qualified demos and meetings for our field sales reps, with clear, well-documented context.
  • Keep CRM hygiene tight — every interaction logged, every pipeline stage accurate. We run on HubSpot. Experience there is a plus but not required.
  • Test outreach approaches, share what’s working, and help us build the playbook as we scale.
  • Partner closely with Marketing on campaigns and Sales on smooth handoffs.

What We’re Looking For

  • Top-of-funnel commercial work — bonus if it’s been in pharmacy, pharma, healthcare, or life sciences.
  • Genuinely comfortable on the phone — you don’t see cold outreach as a chore, you see it as the start of a relationship.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; can hold a thoughtful conversation about pharmacy operations without faking it.
  • Organized and CRM-disciplined — you treat your pipeline like an asset, not a guilty conscience.
  • A working knowledge of — or genuine curiosity about — the compounding pharmacy world, including the regulatory backdrop (503A/503B, and industry bodies like APC and NCPA).
  • Hands-on compounding experience is a real plus but not required. If you've worked in or around a compounding pharmacy, we'd love to hear about it.
  • Self-directed and at ease working independently in a remote environment.

Why CurifyLabs

  • Be the first human voice many pharmacies hear from CurifyLabs — your conversations shape every deal that follows.
  • Real career runway: this role is a launchpad into field sales, account management, or other commercial roles as we scale.
  • Sell something that genuinely matters — compounding pharmacies, their teams, and their patients all benefit.
  • Collaborate with an international, mission-driven team that takes the work seriously and each other a little less so.

How to Apply

Send your CV, salary expectations and a short video on why this role caught your eye through our recruitment portal no later than August 15th. If you want to show off a great cold email or call opener, we won’t complain.

Collinson is the operator of Priority Pass, the world’s original and leading airport experiences programme. As a Senior Salesforce MultiCloud Developer, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing technical solutions across multiple Salesforce Clouds, including Sales, Service, Core, Loyalty Management, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce and Data Cloud. Collaborating closely with Solution Architects and cross-functional technology teams, you will lead the technical design and implementation of Salesforce solutions that enhance customer engagement, loyalty, and operational efficiency. This role demands deep technical knowledge, a strategic mindset, and the ability to both mentor and line-manage junior developers, supporting their performance, development, and growth within the team.

Key Responsibilities

• Advanced Salesforce Development: Lead the development and customisation of complex Salesforce solutions, focusing on CRM, Loyalty Management, Service Cloud, and Agentforce. Utilise advanced Apex, Visualforce, Lightning components, and other Salesforce technologies to extend our capabilities.

• Testing and Quality Assurance: Develop and execute comprehensive test plans to ensure the functionality, performance, and reliability of Salesforce solutions. Perform unit and integration testing. Support user acceptance testing to validate solutions against requirements and acceptance criteria.

Lead the development of data models, sharing models, permission structures and governance practices within Salesforce.

Guide the development team through complex coding challenges and architectural decisions.

• People Leadership and Development: Mentor and line-manage junior Salesforce developers and engineers, supporting performance, development, engagement, and career growth. Promote best practices in coding, configuration, and continuous integration/delivery, while fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and innovation within the team.

• Continuous Learning and Innovation: Keep abreast of the latest Salesforce releases, features, technologies, and best practices. Advocate for the adoption of new tools and technologies that can enhance business outcomes.

Knowledge, skills and experience required

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.

  • 6 + years of experience in Salesforce development, with a proven track record across Salesforce CRM, Service Cloud, and related platform capabilities such as Agentforce. At least 2 years in a senior or lead role.

  • 6+ years of experience with JavaScript

  • Experience building scalable, maintainable Salesforce Flow solutions

  • Strong expertise in Apex, Lightning components, SOQL, and SOSL.

  • Experience with Salesforce integrations using REST APIs, Middleware, Platform Events and other integration tools.

  • Salesforce Developer Certification, Platform Developer II, Salesforce Administrator and any relevant advanced certifications.

  • Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks effectively.

  • Excellent communication and leadership abilities, with experience mentoring developers. Previous experience line-managing, including supporting performance, development, and career growth, is a plus.

  • Experience delivering AI, Agentforce and automation solutions using technologies such as Salesforce Agent force, Data Cloud, Prompt Builder, Agent Script, Claude, APIs and workflow automation tools.

  • Additional Salesforce certifications related to specific clouds (e.g., Service Cloud Consultant, Marketing Cloud Consultant etc) are a plus.

  • Experience with Loyalty Management, Salesforce Voice, Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce, and/or Amazon Connect is a plus.

Person Specification

  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a proactive and analytical approach to challenges

  • Ability to think strategically while maintaining a hands-on focus on solution delivery

  • Comfortable engaging with both technical and non-technical stakeholders across business units

  • Passionate about clean code, maintainable architecture, and continuous improvement

  • Highly organised with excellent time management and prioritization skills

  • Collaborative team player who thrives in cross-functional environments

  • Confident in providing day-to-day people leadership, including line management, coaching, feedback, and supporting the growth of junior team members

  • Committed to self-learning and staying current with Salesforce innovations and ecosystem trends

  • Strong communicator with the ability to explain complex technical ideas in a simple, accessible manner

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to lead the definition of data architecture for a new, data-driven product. This role will focus on assessing, structuring, and integrating fragmented datasets (rankings, submissions, engagement data) to enable a scalable, decision-support platform for in-house legal teams.

The role combines hands-on data analysis with architectural design, shaping how data is ingested, mapped, transformed, and governed to support a viable MVP. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working in early-stage product environments, balancing technical feasibility with product outcomes, and operating across ambiguous data landscapes.

Key Responsibilities

Data Architecture & Discovery

  • Assess data sources, structures, and quality across multiple systems
  • Define data ingestion, mapping, and transformation strategies to unify disparate datasets
  • Design target data architecture to support a scalable MVP (e.g. multi-source integration, golden record approach)
  • Identify gaps, risks, and constraints in current data that impact product feasibility

System Design & Technical Definition

  • Define data models, schemas, and integration patterns aligned to product requirements
  • Establish approaches for data governance, lineage, and quality management
  • Collaborate with product, UX, and engineering to ensure architecture supports user needs and workflows
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, complexity, and scalability in an MVP context

Hands-on Delivery & Prototyping

  • Work directly with datasets to validate assumptions and inform architecture decisions
  • Support prototyping of data flows, pipelines, and transformations
  • Contribute to early-stage technical solutions where required (Python, SQL, etc.)

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with stakeholders to understand data ownership, constraints, and priorities
  • Support user research and validation by ensuring data feasibility aligns with product concepts
  • Translate complex data challenges into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders

Key Qualifications / Skills

  • Proven experience as a Data Architect, Senior Data Engineer, or similar
  • Strong experience working with fragmented or multi-source data environments
  • Ability to operate in discovery / early-stage product definition, not just implementation
  • Experience designing scalable data architectures for analytics or decision-support products
  • Strong communication skills, able to bridge technical and product discussions
  • Familiarity with data governance, mapping, and data quality challenges

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Understanding of data pipeline design, ETL/ELT patterns, and distributed systems
  • Experience with data modelling, schema design, and integration patterns
  • Exposure to modern data architectures (e.g. medallion, event-driven, or similar) is a plus

About Us

HighLevel is an AI powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 1 million businesses, comprised of agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. As of mid 2025, HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.

Our People

With over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

As of mid 2025, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Security Engineer– Application Security & AI Security with 8+ years of experience to help secure HighLevel’s products, platforms, and AI-powered capabilities. This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on building and scaling Application Security practices while driving security initiatives for AI-enabled products.You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and AI teams to embed security into every stage of the software development lifecycle. You’ll provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, influence secure architecture decisions, and help define the future of security across our engineering organization.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Lead Application Security initiatives across HighLevel’s products and engineering teams.
  • Proliferate security standards recommended by central security team as best practices within Dev teams.
  • Conduct architecture reviews, secure design assessments, and threat modeling for new features and platforms.
  • Perform security assessments for Web, Mobile, and API-based applications.
  • Define and drive secure SDLC practices across engineering teams.
  • Partner with developers to identify, prioritize, and remediate security vulnerabilities.
  • Lead security reviews for AI/LLM-powered applications, agents, and AI integrations.
  • Develop security guardrails for AI systems, including protections against prompt injection, data leakage, insecure tool usage, model abuse, and emerging AI attack techniques.
  • Improve security tooling and automate security testing within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Champion secure coding practices through developer enablement, documentation, and training.
  • Drive vulnerability management efforts and improve remediation workflows.
  • Mentor engineers and foster a strong security-first engineering culture.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration by communicating complex security risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders, influencing product roadmaps, and ensuring alignment between security priorities and engineering objectives.
  • Stay current with emerging threats, application security trends, and advancements in AI security.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 8+ years of experience in Cybersecurity, with deep expertise in Application Security and leading engineering-focused security initiatives.
  • Comprehensive technical knowledge in securing Web, Mobile (Android/iOS), and API (REST/GraphQL) environments, including OWASP standards and authentication protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, SAML).
  • Proven experience performing security assessments including threat modeling, secure design/code reviews, penetration testing, and architecture reviews.
  • Hands-on DevSecOps proficiency: automating security in CI/CD pipelines, container security (Kubernetes/Docker), and managing security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA, Secret Scanning).
  • Specialized expertise in AI/LLM security, including mitigation of prompt injection, data leakage, model misuse, and insecure agent/tool integration.
  • Proficiency in programming/scripting (Python, Go, JavaScript, or Bash) and strong communication skills to influence technical stakeholders across product and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience securing workloads on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
    • Experience with Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform).
    • Familiarity with CSPM/CNAPP solutions.
    • Experience leading or participating in Red Teaming, adversary simulation, or purple team exercises.
    • Experience with DevSecOps and security automation.
    • Security certifications such as CEH, OSCP, GWAPT, CISSP, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or similar.
    • Contributions to open-source security projects, bug bounty programs, or security research.

Location: Remote

About Whizz

Whizz is the largest e-bike subscription service for gig delivery workers in North America. We rent maintained, insured e-bikes to independent couriers on a monthly subscription. We operate in six states, with New York as our largest market, and employ 100+ people.

Purpose of the Role

The Head of Finance owns the company's finance and accounting function. This is an operational role. The priority is accurate reporting, disciplined budgeting, and financial control across a physical, asset-heavy business.

Responsibilities

Financial reporting. Own the preparation and accuracy of the P&L, cash flow statement, and balance sheet. Run the monthly close on schedule and ensure the reporting package is consistent, reconciled, and usable by management.

Inventory and fleet accounting. Own how inventory and fixed assets are recorded and reflected in the financial statements. This includes maintaining and improving the capitalization and depreciation policy for bikes, batteries, and spare parts, managing the fixed asset register, accounting for disposals and write-offs, and reconciling operational inventory records against the general ledger.

Budgeting and financial model. Maintain the company's financial model for internal planning purposes. Build the annual and quarterly budgets with department heads, track actual performance against plan, and report variances with recommended corrective action.

Financial control. Build the financial control function: approval and authorization procedures, spend controls, segregation of duties, and regular controls over cash, receivables, and payables.

Team and external partners. Manage in-house accountants and the outsourced accounting firm, define the division of work between them, and hold both to agreed deadlines and quality standards.

Compliance and operations. Oversee payroll, multi-state tax registrations and filings, statutory reporting, and audit readiness. Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, collections, and payment processing operations.

Cross-functional Work

The Head of Finance works directly with the operations, supply chain, and product teams on projects such as pricing changes, new city launches, vendor contracts, warehouse and inventory processes, and payment system changes. The role is expected to identify and address the financial and accounting implications of these projects at the design stage.

Industry: Computer & Network Security

About the position

The Talent Acquisition Associate supports the organization's hiring objectives by managing full-cycle recruitment for assigned positions while providing operational support across the hiring lifecycle. This role partners with hiring managers and the People team to attract top talent, deliver an exceptional candidate experience, coordinate recruiting activities, and ensure efficient, compliant hiring processes. The position also contributes to employer branding, talent pipeline development, and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen the organization's overall talent strategy.

Responsibilities

Recruitment & Candidate Management

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for assigned entry- and mid-level positions, utilizing established recruiting processes and best practices to achieve hiring goals.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, develop recruiting strategies, and provide ongoing updates throughout the hiring process.
  • Source, screen, and advance qualified candidates through the recruitment lifecycle while delivering exceptional candidate experience.
  • Prepare employment offers, coordinate approvals, and facilitate offer acceptance in partnership with hiring managers and People leadership.

Recruiting Operations & Administration

  • Coordinate interview scheduling, background checks, offer documentation, and pre-employment activities to ensure an efficient hiring process.
  • Maintain accurate requisitions, candidate records, and recruiting activity within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), ensuring data integrity and compliance.
  • Support recruiting operations through reporting, documentation, process administration, and onboarding coordination.

Employer Branding & Talent Attraction

  • Support employer branding initiatives through recruiting campaigns, social media, career fairs, networking events, and talent attraction activities.
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines through proactive sourcing, networking, employee referrals, and community engagement.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve recruiting processes, operational efficiency, and the candidate and hiring manager experience.
  • Participate in talent acquisition projects and stay current on recruiting trends, sourcing strategies, and recruiting technologies.

Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications, Psychology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 1–3 years of experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, recruiting coordination, human resources, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting full-cycle recruitment and utilizing an Applicant Tracking System (ATS), preferably Greenhouse.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to build effective relationships and deliver an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience.
  • Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to maintain confidential information.
  • Demonstrated initiative, adaptability, and commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams.
  • Foundational knowledge of recruiting best practices, sourcing techniques, employment laws, and talent acquisition processes.
  • Experience leveraging AI-enabled recruiting or sourcing tools to improve efficiency is preferred.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience. 

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. 

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.   

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect.   

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen.  

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.
