raw.description:
The Opportunity

Compliance at U.S. RIAs, broker-dealers, and wealth fintechs still runs largely on manual review — analysts reading marketing materials line by line, scanning communications for keywords, and reviewing trades and trade requests by hand. Across more than 25,000 firms, operational costs are significant, and regulatory exposure is even greater.

Global RegTech spend is projected to grow from roughly $12B to more than $66B over the next decade, with the US growing to $32B. The teams that ship credible, audit-ready platforms in the next 18 months will define the category. We intend to be one of them.

The Venture

The answer is not another rules engine. We are building an explainable AI platform that reasons like a senior compliance officer, cites firm policy and SEC/FINRA regulations for every decision, and produces audit-ready evidence on demand — across marketing, communications, trading, policy, audit, and filings.

The platform is designed to operate alongside the systems compliance teams already use, replacing manual review with explainable AI judgments that hold up to regulator scrutiny. The roadmap moves from marketing review into communications surveillance, policy and manuals, audit, and ultimately regulatory filings and enterprise integrations.

The Partnership

The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, and the market work is complete. What remains is to bring on the technical co-founder — a partner who will own product and engineering with the same conviction, urgency, and ownership stake.

This is a co-founder role, not a CPTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, a board or board-observer seat as appropriate to the cap table and stage, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CPTO, you will write the first lines of production code, set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

  • Architecture & Engineering Culture — Establish the core architecture, engineering culture, and security posture, including SOC 2 readiness, tenant isolation, encryption, and audit logging
  • Product Build — Ship a marketing review prototype into production with a design partner early adopter, then deliver communications surveillance, trading oversight, audit-ready logs and reporting; release GA v1 covering all core modules except regulatory filings within 9 months, and expand into regulatory filings and enterprise integrations through 18 months
  • AI/LLM Build — Own the training and constant evolution of the core AI/LLM model, delivering robust and highly reliable analysis
  • Explainability & Reliability — Own the explainability layer that produces audit-ready evidence on demand, and the reliability engineering that ensures the platform performs consistently in the field
  • Customer & Market — Represent the company in front of all customer constituencies and third-party interests, as well as investors, as the technical voice of the venture
  • Capital — Convert pilots into ten paying customers and reach $1M ARR within 18 months, partnering with the CEO on conversion and fundraising
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding engineering and applied AI team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Shipped LLM-powered systems into production environments where incorrect outputs carried real consequences — not prototypes or demonstrations
  • Full-stack confidence across applied LLMs, RAG, retrieval, deterministic rules engines, human-in-the-loop workflows, observability, and secure multi-tenant SaaS (SOC 2, tenant isolation, encryption, audit logging)
  • Well-formed convictions about explainability and reliability engineering, developed through direct production experience
  • Preference for systems that perform consistently in the field over systems that demonstrate well in controlled settings
  • Prepared to operate as a principal — setting the technical agenda, making decisive calls under uncertainty, and owning the outcomes that follow
  • Strongly preferred: prior founder, founding engineer, or early-stage technical leadership experience; background in legal tech, RegTech, fintech compliance, healthcare, or another high-trust regulated vertical; familiarity with the U.S. wealth management ecosystem, including SEC and FINRA workflows, marketing review, communications surveillance, and trade monitoring; direct experience self-hosting or privately deploying foundation models

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

raw.excerpt: Dailymotion est en pleine transformation technique : nous migrons une architecture monolithique vers une architecture cloud-native en microservices.
raw.description:
Dailymotion est en pleine transformation technique : nous migrons une architecture monolithique vers une architecture cloud-native en microservices. C'est l'un des chantiers les plus structurants de notre histoire récente, et l'équipe APIs & Performance en est un pilier central.

C'est une équipe de profils seniors, autonomes, qui savent ce qu'ils ont à faire au quotidien. Ce qu'elle attend de son manager, c'est quelqu'un qui se pose les bonnes questions avant que les problèmes n'arrivent, qui structure sans bureaucratiser, et qui a la conviction que les petits gestes du quotidien font la différence à l'échelle. On ne cherche pas un gestionnaire qui exécute une roadmap qu'on lui donne. On cherche quelqu'un qui la challenge, qui identifie les angles morts, et qui pousse l'équipe à automatiser ce qu'elle fait déjà bien pour aller encore plus loin.

Ce n'est pas ta capacité à rester hands-on qui fera avancer les sujets, mais ta capacité à rester suffisamment proche de la tech pour challenger les bons choix, comprendre en profondeur les enjeux d'architecture et de scalabilité, et embarquer des devs seniors sur le fond.

Ce que tu feras

  • Prendre la responsabilité de l'équipe APIs & Performance : 5 devs back + pilotage de 6 prestataires, avec un vrai mandat pour structurer son fonctionnement : backlog, grooming, scrum, priorisation
  • Pousser l'équipe vers le next level sur l'IA : Elle maîtrise déjà bien l'automatisation du développement ; l'enjeu, c'est d'aller plus loin : automatiser les workflows, industrialiser la génération de tests, exploiter l'IA pour le monitoring et la détection d'anomalies. Tu es capable d'insuffler cette culture au quotidien, pas juste de la prôner en réunion
  • Apporter ta sensibilité "prod" : issue d'une expérience de migration ou de modernisation à échelle, quel que soit le rôle que tu occupais à l'époque (dev, archi, manager). Tu sais qu'on ne coupe pas une fonctionnalité du jour au lendemain, et cette conscience infuse chacune de tes décisions
  • Installer une culture où l'information remonte naturellement : Où chacun se sent porteur de l'avancement des sujets, sans attendre une sollicitation du manager
  • Collaborer avec le VP Core Software sur l'opérationnel du quotidien : T'inscrire dans la vision long terme du périmètre portée par la direction technique : exécution, maintenabilité, scalabilité, monitoring

Les Must Have

  • Background technique solide et capacité à saisir les enjeux backend, API, perf et migration
  • +6 ans d'expérience en management, avec une vraie dynamique de transformation plutôt qu'une gestion de l'existant en pilote automatique
  • Une expérience concrète, déjà vécue, d'un projet de migration ou de modernisation à échelle (quel que soit le rôle occupé à l'époque : dev, archi, manager)
  • Une culture IA forte, avec une vraie expérience de mise en place d'une dynamique "IA first" dans une équipe de devs seniors
  • Français et anglais courants

Les Nice to Have

  • Connaissance des enjeux d'architecture distribuée et de microservices à grande échelle
  • Capacité à traduire les priorités product en décisions techniques concrètes, et inversement
  • Expérience sur des APIs à forte charge ou des enjeux de scalabilité

Ce qui fera la différence

Ta capacité à donner à une équipe déjà autonome l'envie de se dépasser, sans jamais reprendre la main à sa place. C'est cet équilibre entre exigence et confiance, entre cadrer et laisser de l'espace, qui fera la différence entre un manager qui gère au quotidien et un manager qui transforme durablement la façon dont l'équipe travaille.

Organisation du travail

  • Ce poste est ouvert en full remote (en France uniquement) ou en présentiel à Paris

Tu ne coches pas toutes les cases ? Postule quand même.

Nous cherchons la bonne personne, pas le CV parfait. Si ce poste t'enthousiasme mais que ton parcours ne correspond pas exactement à chaque critère, nous voulons quand même te rencontrer.

Dailymotion est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous croyons en l'inclusion et souhaitons t'accueillir pour contribuer à bâtir une communauté plus diverse. Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Besoin d'aménagements durant le processus de recrutement ? Dis-le nous à l'avance, nous nous adapterons.

Processus de recrutement

  • Entretien RH avec Marvin (30 min) : Faire connaissance, parler de tes motivations et aligner les attentes autour du rôle
  • Entretien avec Nyvath, ton futur manager (1h) : Discussion sur ton expérience de management, ta sensibilité technique, ton vécu sur des sujets de migrations. Mises en situation concrètes pour voir comment tu gères le réel
  • Entretien Produit avec Ashish notre VP Product (45mn) : ton mindset produit et ta capacité à traduire des priorités business en décisions techniques
  • Entretien avec David notre CTO (1h) : Discussion sur tes ambitions à long terme, compréhension de la place de ce rôle dans la stratégie de Dailymotion, exploration des perspectives d'évolution au sein de l'organisation

Bienvenue chez Dailymotion 🎉

Dailymotion c'est plus qu’une app vidéo, c’est une conversation visuelle en mouvement qui repose sur un algorithme unique pensé pour développer l'esprit critique des utilisateurs. Dailymotion apporte de la nuance aux débats qui animent la jeunesse et remet l’écoute, la découverte et la bienveillance au cœur des échanges pour contribuer à construire un Internet plus sûr et vertueux.

Dailymotion, c'est aussi "Dailymotion Pro”, une solution d'hébergement et de diffusion vidéo au service des professionnels de tous les secteurs ; et "Dailymotion Advertising", une plateforme vidéo marketing propriétaire et puissante, qui propose un environnement qualitatif et sûr pour les marques.

Notre équipe se compose de 400 collaborateurs en France, à New York et à Singapore, tous unis par la même ambition : faire bouger visiblement les lignes de l’écosystème des plateformes vidéo dans le monde.

Ce qui nous lie?

A Dailymotion, notre équipe composée de talents de plus de 40 nationalités évolue chaque jour en portant quatre valeurs fondamentales:

  • Ouvrir des perspectives - Nous créons des ponts entre des humains de tous horizons. Nous croyons à la liberté d’expression, à l'inclusion et au mélange des cultures.

  • Bâtir un monde plus sûr - Nous cultivons l'empathie, clé pour comprendre l'altérité. Prendre soin les uns des autres est notre moteur pour créer une communauté solidaire et sûre.

  • Faire preuve d'audace - Nous sommes des challengers ambitieux. Nous faisons des choix à contre-courant qui auront un impact visible dans l’écosystème des plateformes.

  • Créer du sens - Nous suscitons la joie et la curiosité, nous nous sentons bien dans ce que nous faisons et nous voulons que tous les autres ressentent la même satisfaction.

raw.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead InfluTracker, an AI-native content intelligence and publishing venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

InfluTracker is an AI-first content intelligence engine that transforms raw information into structured insights and ready-to-publish content. The platform ingests high-signal content from sources like LinkedIn, X, newsletters, blogs, and podcasts, extracts and clusters insights into themes, and generates drafts tailored to individual or brand voice — creating a seamless workflow from input → insight → output. Rather than another point solution for capture, writing, or scheduling, InfluTracker is designed to be the system of record for modern content creation across individuals and teams.

The venture begins with an initial product, real users, and immediate feedback loops to accelerate iteration and go-to-market. We are now seeking the founder to lead the venture from here.

Market Context

  • Content has become a primary distribution channel for founders, operators, marketers, and creators across LinkedIn, X, and newsletters
  • Professionals spend 5–10+ hours per week consuming fragmented information with no system to convert input into structured insights and consistent output
  • High-performing creators publish 3–7x per week with structured workflows, while most professionals lack a repeatable system for insight → content
  • Adjacent categories (social listening, creator tools, AI writing) exceed $10B+ and continue to grow, with clear willingness to pay across Notion, Substack, Hootsuite, and Jasper
  • Expansion path runs from individual creators to teams to enterprise content workflows

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Data Protection & Identity Manager will own and advance Extreme's strategy for both identity governance across both human and non-human (AI agent) identities, as well as the enterprise-wide Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program. Data Loss Prevention (DLP)

  • Strong understanding of zero-trust architecture, least-privilege principles, and privileged access management (PAM)

  • Familiarity with data classification frameworks and sensitivity labelling at enterprise scale

  • Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders without direct authority

  • Strong analytical and risk assessment skills; ability to translate technical risk into business impact

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level reporting

  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities and tasks in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Self-starter with a continuous improvement mindset and a drive to challenge existing processes

Working Schedule

Monday–Friday, 40 hours per week. On-call rotation required for high-severity DLP or identity incidents outside standard hours.

Experience & Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Information Security, with a minimum of 3 years in identity governance, IAM, or data protection roles

  • Experience securing environments with significant AI/ML or automation workloads is strongly preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, SailPoint, or equivalent IGA platforms

About the role

As a Sr. Solution Principal – Microsoft AI & Innovation, you will be a key presales leader responsible for shaping and selling AI-led professional services across the Microsoft ecosystem. You will consult with clients, assess their AI readiness and Microsoft estate, define pragmatic AI adoption roadmaps, and translate them into clearly scoped professional services Statements of Work (SOWs). Your remit spans the full Microsoft surface area — Modern Work (Microsoft 365, Copilot, Teams), Capability (Azure platform, infrastructure, and security foundations), Application Development (Azure AI, Copilot Studio, custom agents), and Data & AI (Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Foundry) — with a heavy focus on Microsoft Agent 365 and enterprise AI strategy.

As agentic AI moves from experimentation to enterprise-scale operation, clients need a trusted advisor who can connect AI ambition to a governed, secure, and value-driven adoption path. You will be that advisor — shaping how organizations deploy, govern, and scale AI agents responsibly on Microsoft.

You will need a balance of:

  • Strategic presales acumen across the Microsoft AI portfolio
  • Deep understanding of AI adoption, Agent 365 governance, and the Microsoft Cloud
  • Business consulting and AI strategy skills
  • Strong SOW and deal-structuring experience

You will partner closely with account teams, solution architects, and delivery leaders to design AI-driven solutions that achieve measurable client outcomes.

In this role, you will:

Client consulting & discovery

  • Align into top accounts to build relationships with senior IT and business stakeholders (CIO, CDO, CTO, CISO, Head of Modern Work, and Line-of-Business leaders).
  • Lead AI discovery and readiness workshops to understand current-state Microsoft estate, workplace productivity patterns, data landscape, governance maturity, and agent adoption readiness.
  • Assess the client’s Microsoft footprint — Microsoft 365 and Copilot adoption, Azure platform maturity, identity and security posture (Entra, Purview, Defender), and data estate (Fabric, Azure data services) — to identify pain points and AI opportunities.
  • Translate business objectives into prioritized AI use cases and adoption roadmaps spanning Copilot rollout, custom agent development, Agent 365 governance, and modern data foundations.

AI strategy & solution architecture

  • Define future-state Microsoft AI architectures that span Modern Work, Capability, Application Development, and Data & AI — anchored on Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, and Microsoft Agent 365.
  • Shape enterprise AI strategy: help clients move from ad hoc agent experimentation to a governed operating model, defining how agents are identified, owned, secured, and scaled.
  • Position Microsoft Agent 365 as the control plane for AI agents — covering agent identity (Microsoft Entra Agent ID), observability, governance, security, and lifecycle management across first-party, custom, and third-party agents.
  • Recommend responsible-AI and Zero Trust patterns that align agent access with least-privilege, Conditional Access, data protection (Purview), and threat protection (Defender).
  • Craft outcome-focused solution narratives that connect AI investments to business value (productivity gains, faster time-to-insight, reduced manual effort, trusted and governed automation).
  • Collaborate with technical SMEs (AI engineers, data engineers, app developers, cloud and security architects) to validate feasibility, sizing, and delivery approach.

SOW creation & deal structuring

  • Lead the creation of professional services proposals and SOWs across the Microsoft AI portfolio (AI readiness assessments, Copilot adoption, agent development, Agent 365 governance enablement, data modernization, and app modernization for AI).
  • Define scope, deliverables, assumptions, and client responsibilities with enough detail to enable predictable delivery.
  • Design deal structures that meet internal margin targets, align with preferred delivery models (fixed-fee, T&M, multi-phase roadmaps), and match client expectations and risk tolerance.
  • Work with resource management and delivery leaders to develop realistic staffing and ramp plans based on skills, availability, and project timelines.
  • Ensure SOWs adhere to Insight’s standards, legal/commercial guidelines, and risk controls.

Sales collaboration & pipeline support

  • Engage with sellers to refine understanding of client needs during qualification and shape win strategies for Microsoft AI opportunities.
  • Support account teams in early-stage opportunity shaping, including ideation of AI engagements (assessments, PoCs, Copilot pilots, agent programs, multi-phase transformations).
  • Represent client needs across all Insight capabilities, with a focus on expanding AI deal size and attaching services to Microsoft platform and licensing investments.
  • Support sellers in executive presentations, proposal walkthroughs, and orals — clearly articulating our Microsoft AI value proposition and differentiation.
  • Participate in internal deal reviews with Insight leadership, presenting solution approach, delivery risks, and financials.

Partner engagement & offerings

  • Develop strong working relationships with Microsoft field and product teams and incorporate the latest Microsoft AI capabilities (Copilot, Agent 365, Azure AI Foundry, Fabric) into client solutions.
  • Leverage Microsoft partner incentives and funding (PoCs, pilots, workshops, assessments, FastTrack) to accelerate AI opportunities.
  • Provide feedback into Insight’s Microsoft AI offerings and accelerators based on client demand and field experience.

Governance, quality & reporting

Experience

Depth in enterprise AI governance and Agent 365, including:

  • Agent observability, discovery/registry, and centralized policy-driven governance.
  • Security and compliance for agents via Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Purview.
  • Ability to assess a client’s AI maturity and propose pragmatic, phased roadmaps (assess → foundation → use-case enablement → govern & scale).
  • Strong understanding of clients’ IT and business decision-making process, especially for AI, productivity, and platform investments.
  • Demonstrated ability to solution across multiple business units and offerings, integrating Modern Work, Cloud, Data, AI, Apps, and Managed Services where appropriate.

Excellent communication skills:

Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Manager, Strategic Planning & Operations, Digital Product Management

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will serve as a strategic partner to the VP Digital Product Management and senior leaders, translating Digital Product Management strategy into measurable priorities, operating plans, and outcomes. You will facilitate strategic planning, organizational effectiveness, technology and AI-enabled initiatives, business operations, and executive communications across the AI & Data organization.

This role combines strategic thinking, operational leadership, and organizational influence to accelerate delivery of transformative technology across the company.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Planning

  • Deliver strategic and operational support to the VP and senior leadership team, ensuring the effective execution of business strategies, initiatives, policies, and procedures that drive departmental success.
  • Translate strategic priorities into measurable goals, action plans, milestones, KPIs, and accountability frameworks that improve decision-making and execution across the function.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner on portfolio, organizational, capability, and investment decisions.
  • Shape and run annual operating rhythms (LT offsites, staff meetings, and readouts).

Chief of Staff

  • Manage day-to-day execution of departmental strategy, supporting cross-functional priorities, key decisions, and follow-through.
  • Own agenda planning, coordination, and facilitation for leadership meetings and offsites.
  • Serve as the connective tissue across AI&D leaders, tracking key initiatives and ensuring alignment.

Enhancing organizational effectiveness and culture

• Drive leadership team effectiveness, operating cadence, and cross-functional alignment across the Digital Product Management organization.

• Lead high-priority special projects involving organizational design, talent strategy, capability building, change management, and operational improvement.

• Contribute to a strong culture by supporting offsites, seminar series, training, staff profiles, mentoring connections, and other engagement mechanisms.

• Establish practical processes, tools, and ways of working that improve transparency, accountability, learning, and execution.

Lead business operations and executive communications

• Coordinate budgeting, resource planning, headcount management, and scenario analyses in partnership with Finance, HR, Research Operations, and TA leadership.

• Coordinate talent management processes, including hiring, promotions, workforce planning, and related personnel actions.

• Develop executive-level presentations, business reviews, strategic communications, governance materials, portfolio reviews, and leadership updates.

• Lead departmental communications strategy and content calendar, including newsletters, events, and executive updates.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The strategic and operational leader we seek is a Senior Manager with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications

  • Doctorate degree and 2+ years of strategic planning, business operations, or consulting experience
    OR
  • Master’s degree and 4+ years of the same experience
    OR
  • Bachelor’s degree and 6+ years of relevant experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced degree in strategy, management, or related field
  • Experience in life sciences, biotech, or AI/data-driven organizations
  • Exceptional executive presence, judgment, and communication skills
  • Proven track record leading strategic initiatives and operating with agility
  • Expertise with executive-level presentation, change management, and cross-functional planning
  • High EQ and comfort navigating ambiguity with diplomacy and influence

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental & vision coverage, and life & disability insurance
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

careers.amgen.com

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Sponsorship

Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Job Title: Senior Manager, Federal Solutions & SalesJob Category: Business Development and MarketingTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: NoneEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking a Senior Manager, Federal Solutions & Sales for our Enterprise Cloud Solutions (ECS) group. This is a senior, customer-facing leadership role for a player-coach who combines technical depth, consultative selling ability, and team leadership.

This role is ideal for someone who has built a career at the intersection of technology, customer engagement, and go-to-market execution within the Federal market. You will lead a small, focused team that includes Account Managers, Sales Engineers or technical presales resources, and Marketing support, while also personally engaging with prospective and existing customers to understand their environments, uncover pain points, and shape practical solutions.

Rather than serving only as a traditional new-logo hunter, this leader will act as a trusted advisor who can sit with customer stakeholders, understand mission and technical challenges, assess where ECS solutions are a fit, identify capability gaps, and help guide internal teams on how solutions should evolve to better meet customer needs. The right candidate can bridge customer conversations, technical architecture, product strategy, and sales execution.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in cloud, enterprise IT, platform solutions, or solutions architecture, along with experience leading teams and supporting business growth in Federal, Defense, or National Security environments.

Responsibilities:

Serve as a senior customer-facing leader for ECS, engaging directly with prospective and existing customers to understand mission needs, technical environments, operational pain points, and buying considerations.

Lead consultative discovery conversations with customer stakeholders, including technical teams, program offices, and business decision-makers, to determine how ECS offerings can address customer challenges.

Translate customer needs into solution approaches, clearly articulating where ECS capabilities align, where there are gaps, and what enhancements or alternative approaches may be needed.

Partner closely with engineering, product, and delivery teams to communicate field feedback and help inform roadmap priorities, solution improvements, and capability development.

Provide leadership and day-to-day direction for ECS Account Management, Sales Engineering/technical presales, and Marketing resources, including coaching, prioritization, performance management, and professional development.

Support the sales team in shaping opportunities, developing account strategies, and advancing deals through technically credible and customer-specific solutioning.

Work with Account Managers to support customer retention, account growth, and expansion opportunities within existing ECS customers.

Partner with Sales Engineers and technical teams to develop and deliver compelling demonstrations, workshops, whiteboarding sessions, and solution discussions tailored to customer needs.

Help build a more repeatable and scalable go-to-market motion by refining sales plays, discovery frameworks, qualification methods, and account pursuit strategies.

Own visibility into the ECS pipeline, including opportunity progression, forecasting inputs, and regular updates to senior leadership.

Represent ECS at customer meetings, industry events, and conferences, helping build awareness, credibility, and trust in the market.

Monitor customer needs, market trends, and competitor positioning, and provide actionable insights to product and executive leadership.

Support the development of strategic partnerships and channel relationships, including with cloud providers and systems integrators relevant to ECS offerings.

Work across a distributed team in a remote environment, ensuring alignment, communication, and accountability across functions.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in Federal technology, solutions engineering, technical sales, solution architecture, customer success, business development, or related customer-facing leadership roles.
  • Strong background in cloud platforms, enterprise IT, infrastructure, platforms, or software solutions, with the ability to engage credibly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead customer discovery conversations, assess pain points, and translate customer needs into practical solution recommendations.
  • Experience identifying where products or platforms are a fit, where they are not, and how they may need to evolve to better support customer requirements.
  • Track record of partnering effectively across sales, engineering, product, and delivery teams to support customer outcomes and business growth.
  • Experience managing teams, preferably across sales, account management, solutions engineering, or related go-to-market functions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex technical capabilities in a clear, customer-friendly way.
  • Familiarity with Federal procurement environments and how technology solutions are evaluated and purchased in government settings.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a remote environment across multiple time zones with a distributed team.
  • U.S. citizenship with ability to obtain a Secret or Top Secret security clearance.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience working with DoD, National Security, or Intelligence Community customers.
  • Background in solutions architecture, cloud architecture, technical presales, or similar consultative technical roles.
  • Familiarity with AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI in regulated or mission-oriented environments.
  • Understanding of DoD cloud adoption constraints and compliance considerations, including IL5/IL6, Zero Trust, and related frameworks.
  • Experience supporting or leading technical discovery, capability demonstrations, workshops, or proof-of-concept efforts.
  • Familiarity with Federal contract vehicles, procurement pathways, and acquisition processes.
  • Experience translating customer feedback into product or roadmap recommendations.
  • Current clearance, including Secret, Top Secret, or TS/SCI.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$95,500-$210,100

We are seeking a commercially minded Finance Analyst to support Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and play a key role in the financial onboarding and integration of a new brand into the YSI portfolio.

This role will partner closely with senior leadership, product, marketing, operations, and external stakeholders to deliver accurate forecasting, financial insights, and performance reporting during a critical phase of expansion.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, comfortable in a fast-paced growth environment, and eager to work at the forefront of digital interactive businesses.

About Visio Lending

Visio Lending is the nation’s leader in rental home financing. Founded in 2012 in Austin, Texas, Visio enables small- to medium- sized investors to grow their rental home and vacation rental portfolios. Headquartered in fantastic Austin, Texas, since late 2015, Visio has financed more than $1 billion in Rental360 loans. With more than $400 million in capital onboard, a proven record of investment grade bond issuance on Wall Street, and an outstanding 100+ team, Visio is poised for continued success.

Why We Love Working at Visio:

We at Visio are passionate about working together towards our goals to continually push this company forward. We innovate, collaborate, celebrate team successes, and recognize individual accomplishments. At Visio Lending, you’ll work on meaningful initiatives that directly support real estate investors nationwide. We offer a collaborative culture, growth opportunities, and flexibility with remote or hybrid work options.

How to Apply?

To be considered for employment, please submit your application online. While we appreciate all the interest we receive, only candidates selected for phone screening, or an interview will be contacted directly. You will receive application status alerts via email so make sure your email address is accurate.

Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. Unanswered application questions or responses indicating “see resume” will be considered incomplete and you will be removed from consideration.

Visio Financial Services, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer

The Opportunity:

As a UAT Coordinator, you will lead the planning, coordination, and execution of user acceptance testing (UAT) for Visio Lending's software solutions. Working closely with Business Systems Analysts, business stakeholders, and Engineering teams, you'll organize testing cycles, guide end users through the UAT process, track defects and approvals, and communicate testing progress and release readiness. Your efforts will help ensure new features and system enhancements meet business requirements and are ready for a successful launch.

If you are an organized, collaborative professional who enjoys coordinating cross-functional teams, keeping projects on track, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks, this role is for you. You'll thrive if you're a strong communicator with exceptional attention to detail, enjoy solving problems, and are passionate about delivering high-quality solutions that support the business.

What You'll Do

  • Plan, schedule, and coordinate UAT cycles across releases and projects
  • Partner with business systems analysts (BSAs) to translate requirements into UAT test plans and test cases
  • Recruit, onboard, and guide business users who serve as UAT testers
  • Maintain the UAT schedule, entry/exit criteria, and readiness checklists
  • Track test execution progress, defects, and resolution status, and report regularly on UAT health
  • Facilitate defect triage and communication between business testers and engineering
  • Manage UAT sign-off, approvals, and supporting documentation
  • CommunicateUAT status, risks, and go/no-go recommendations to stakeholders
  • Coordinatetest environment and test data readiness with technical teams
  • Maintain UAT documentation, templates, and process standards, and drive continuous improvement
  • Contribute to agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives as needed
  • Other responsibilities and duties as assigned based on business needs
  • Authorized Remote Locations: AL, AR, AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MI, NC, SC, TX, UT
  • Salary Range: $75,000 - $100,000 (Exempt level position)

What We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, information systems, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 3- 5 years of experience coordinating UAT, software testing, or project delivery
  • Proven experience organizing and leading test cycles that involve business or non-technical testers
  • Experiencecollaborating with business systems analysts (BSAs) to build test plans and test cases
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and UAT methodologies
  • Proficiency with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail)
  • Excellent organizational, scheduling, and stakeholder communication skills
  • A clear communicator who can bridge business and technical teams
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent test cycles and competing priorities
  • Ability to use standard office equipment, printer, scanner, copier, fax, telephone, personal computer, and other peripheral devices

What We Prefer to Find:

  • Experience in mortgage lending, financial services, or another regulated industry
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies
  • Abilityto write basic SQL queries to validate data

raw.description:
Job Title: Director of Clinical Services

Reports To: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

Employment Type: Full-Time | Exempt

Location: Remote (U.S.) must reside in VA

Compensation: $80,000-$95,000 annually

About Virtual Peace of Mind (VPM)

Virtual Peace of Mind (VPM) is a fast-growing, fully remote mental health practice dedicated to providing compassionate, evidence-based care to youth and families across multiple states. Our mission is to expand equitable access to mental health services through high-quality virtual care — and to support the clinicians and professionals who make that care possible.

We’re building a culture that ismission-driven, accountable, supportive, and built for sustainable remote work.

Why Join VPM

At VPM, you’ll be part of a team transforming access to youth mental health through virtual care — with a remote model designed to support excellent work and real life.

What you can expect:

  • Mission-Driven Impact:Contribute to meaningful work improving access and outcomes for youth and families.
  • Remote by Design:Fully remote environment with clear expectations and supportive infrastructure.
  • Collaborative Culture:Work with a multidisciplinary team that values integrity, empathy, and shared learning.
  • Growth & Leadership Pathways:Opportunities to expand scope and take on leadership or consulting responsibilities as we scale.
  • Professional Development:Access to training, resources, and continued learning opportunities aligned to role scope.
  • State & School-Based Partnerships:Join initiatives that strengthen school-based mental health delivery and expand access across communities.

Position Summary

The Director of Clinical Services serves as the senior clinical leader for Virtual Peace of Mind and is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational oversight, quality assurance, and successful delivery of all clinical services across the organization. This executive leadership position provides direction for clinical operations, workforce development, clinical education and apprenticeship programming, program implementation, and clinical compliance while ensuring the delivery of high-quality, evidence-based behavioral health services across all programs and service lines.

The Director of Clinical Services is responsible for leading clinical teams, strengthening relationships with school districts and other strategic partners, overseeing the successful implementation of organizational initiatives, and ensuring that clinical services align with the mission, vision, and strategic goals of Virtual Peace of Mind. The Director collaborates closely with executive leadership to develop scalable clinical systems that support organizational growth, operational excellence, and exceptional client outcomes. A primary responsibility of this position is designing and building the infrastructure for Virtual Peace of Mind’s 16-month clinical apprenticeship program, including its weekly curriculum, learning objectives, competencies, training activities, evaluation tools, and implementation standards.

Serving as the CEO's designee for clinical operations, the Director assumes primary responsibility for the day-to-day oversight of clinical services, clinical personnel, and implementation activities, allowing the CEO to focus on organizational strategy, statewide

expansion, business development, grants, and executive partnerships.

This position requires a seasoned behavioral health executive with demonstrated experience directing clinical services, leading multidisciplinary teams, implementing large-scale programs, and building strategic partnerships. The ideal candidate possesses strong operational leadership skills, excellent relationship management abilities, and a proven record of improving clinical quality, organizational performance, and program outcomes.

Clinical Leadership & Quality

The Director of Clinical Services provides executive leadership for all clinical service delivery across Virtual Peace of Mind. This includes establishing and maintaining high standards of clinical excellence, ensuring compliance with ethical and regulatory requirements, promoting evidence-based practices, and fostering a culture of continuous quality improvement. The Director is responsible for ensuring that clinical services are delivered consistently, effectively, and in alignment with the organization's mission and strategic goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide executive oversight of clinical quality, service delivery, clinical risk, and regulatory compliance across all programs and service lines.
  • Establish systems for monitoring documentation, treatment planning, client outcomes, clinical performance, and corrective action.
  • Lead quality assurance, performance improvement, and clinical policy development.
  • Supervise and develop Clinical Supervisors and other clinical leaders while providing consultation regarding complex, high-risk, or escalated clinical matters.

Clinical Education, Workforce Development & Apprenticeship

The Director of Clinical Services has primary executive responsibility for designing, building, implementing, evaluating, and continuously improving Virtual Peace of Mind’s clinical education, apprenticeship, and workforce development infrastructure. This includes developing a comprehensive apprenticeship program that prepares future behavioral health professionals through a structured, competency-based learning experience. The Director will establish the educational infrastructure, curriculum, training standards, supervision model, and evaluation framework necessary to support clinician development and long-term workforce sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and complete a comprehensive 16-month clinical apprenticeship curriculum organized by week, with defined learning objectives, competencies, instructional content, applied activities, supervision expectations, performance milestones, and required deliverables.
  • Develop the full educational infrastructure necessary to operate the program, including facilitator guides, participant materials, training manuals, competency assessments, evaluation tools, progress-tracking systems, and remediation procedures.
  • Establish a structured apprenticeship model integrating clinical instruction, supervised practice, documentation proficiency, professional development, organizational orientation, and readiness for increasingly independent clinical responsibilities.
  • Coordinate the implementation, delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement of the apprenticeship program in collaboration with clinical supervisors, organizational leadership, and applicable external partners.
  • Ensure the apprenticeship curriculum aligns with organizational standards, applicable licensure and supervision requirements, evidence-based clinical practices, workforce needs, and contractual or funding requirements.

Add a curriculum development expectation

During the initial curriculum-development period, the Director is expected to demonstrate measurable weekly progress toward completion of the 16-month apprenticeship framework in accordance with an approved project plan and implementation timeline.

Clinical Operations & Workforce Performance

The Director of Clinical Services oversees the operational management of all clinical programs, ensuring appropriate staffing, efficient workflows, and effective resource utilization. Working collaboratively with administrative leadership, the Director develops systems that support sustainable growth while maintaining exceptional service delivery. This role is responsible for maintaining a high-performing clinical workforce, strengthening accountability, and ensuring that staffing capacity, clinician productivity, supervision, and service delivery support the organization’s current and future needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Direct daily clinical operations, staffing capacity, clinical assignments, supervision structures, and escalation processes.
  • Collaborate with administrative and human resources leadership on clinician recruitment, selection, onboarding, performance management, retention, and workforce planning.
  • Establish and monitor systems for clinical productivity, caseload management, service access, documentation timeliness, and operational performance.
  • Use clinical, workforce, utilization, and operational data to identify trends, resolve barriers, recommend improvements, and ensure contractual and organizational expectations are achieved.

Strategic Partnerships & Program Implementation

The Director of Clinical Services serves as the organization's senior clinical representative in cultivating and maintaining strategic partnerships that support the delivery and expansion of behavioral health services. This includes collaborating with school districts, healthcare organizations, government agencies, referral partners, and other stakeholders to ensure successful program implementation and long-term partnership success. The Director plays a critical role in representing Virtual Peace of Mind's clinical expertise while supporting organizational growth and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as Virtual Peace of Mind’s senior clinical liaison with school districts, principals, district administrators, state agencies, healthcare organizations, government entities, referral partners, grant partners, and other strategic stakeholders.
  • Represent the organization in implementation meetings, clinical planning discussions, partnership reviews, service-delivery meetings, and other assigned external engagements.
  • Lead the clinical implementation of new contracts, programs, districts, grants, and service lines, ensuring that timelines, staffing, workflows, communication protocols, and deliverables are established and maintained.
  • Develop and execute partner-specific engagement and improvement plans that strengthen utilization, service access, satisfaction, program performance, and long-term partnership stability.
  • Address and resolve partner concerns related to clinical services, program implementation, workforce readiness, and service delivery.

Executive Leadership & Organizational Strategy

As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the Director of Clinical Services contributes to organizational planning, strategic decision-making, and long-term growth initiatives. The Director collaborates with the CEO to develop scalable clinical systems, strengthen organizational performance, and ensure that clinical operations align with the overall vision and direction of Virtual Peace of Mind.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in executive leadership, organizational planning, strategic decision-making, and the development of scalable clinical systems.
  • Lead assigned strategic initiatives that strengthen clinical quality, organizational efficiency, workforce development, program implementation, and service growth.
  • Use clinical, operational, workforce, partnership, and financial information to provide executive-level reports, recommendations, and corrective-action plans.
  • Assist with developing and monitoring clinical department budgets, staffing investments, training resources, apprenticeship expenditures, and other assigned organizational resources.
  • Serve as the CEO’s designee for day-to-day clinical operations, assigned partnership matters, program implementation, and clinical leadership decisions.

Authority & Decision-Making

The Director of Clinical Services is authorized to make day-to-day clinical and operational decisions necessary to ensure effective service delivery, workforce performance, program implementation, clinical quality, and partnership responsiveness. The Director exercises independent judgment in supervising clinical personnel, resolving routine operational concerns, implementing approved initiatives, establishing clinical workflows, and directing assigned resources. Decisions involving contract execution, unapproved financial

commitments, executive compensation, significant organizational restructuring, enterprise-wide policy changes, or other matters reserved for ownership remain subject to approval by the Chief Executive Officer.

Leadership Development & Organizational Culture

The Director of Clinical Services is responsible for cultivating a culture of clinical excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous professional growth. Through mentorship, coaching, and leadership development, the Director builds organizational capacity by developing future leaders and fostering an environment that supports employee engagement, innovation, and exceptional client care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Mentor, coach, evaluate, and develop Clinical Supervisors and emerging clinical leaders.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and promote accountability, collaboration, employee engagement, and professional growth.
  • Develop leadership-development and succession plans that strengthen the organization’s long-term clinical leadership capacity.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, ethical practice, continuous improvement, and exceptional client care.

Minimum Qualifications

Education

  • Master's or Doctoral Degree in Counseling, Social Work, Psychology, Marriage & Family Therapy, or related behavioral health discipline.

Licensure

Current unrestricted professional license in Virginia (LPC, LCSW, Licensed Clinical Psychologist, LMFT, or equivalent).

Clinical Supervision Qualification

Must meet applicable Virginia requirements to provide or become approved to provide clinical supervision to residents or supervisees in the candidate’s professional discipline. Board-approved supervisor status at the time of hire is required.

Required Experience

  • Minimum 8 years of progressive clinical experience.
  • Minimum 5 years in a Director-level clinical leadership role
  • Minimum 3 years supervising licensed behavioral health professionals.
  • Demonstrated experience directing clinical programs or behavioral health departments.
  • Demonstrated experience managing external partnerships and implementing behavioral health services within school systems, healthcare organizations, government programs, community behavioral health settings, or comparable institutional environments.
  • Experience leading organizational change and program implementation.
  • Experience developing policies, procedures, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Experience managing multiple clinicians across multiple programs.
  • Demonstrated experience designing structured clinical training, professional development, workforce education, apprenticeship, residency, or competency-based learning programs.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-phase projects with defined timelines, deliverables, performance measures, and stakeholder accountability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a Clinical Director, Director of Behavioral Health, Director of Clinical Services, or equivalent senior leadership role.
  • Experience managing grant-funded behavioral health initiatives.
  • Experience working with public school districts.
  • Experience scaling behavioral health programs.
  • Experience working with telebehavioral health services.
  • Experience developing comprehensive clinical curricula, training academies, apprenticeship programs, or graduate-level instructional content.
  • Experience with learning management systems, instructional design, adult learning principles, or competency-based education.
  • Experience developing and managing clinical department budgets.
  • Experience implementing performance dashboards and data-informed quality improvement systems.

Competencies

  • Executive Leadership
  • Clinical Excellence
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Relationship Management
  • Conflict Resolution
  • Organizational Development
  • Team Leadership
  • Change Management
  • Public Speaking/Teaching/Training
  • Emotional Intelligence
  • Decision-Making
  • Program Implementation
  • Systems Development
  • Curriculum Design and Instructional Planning
  • Data-Informed Leadership
  • Financial Stewardship
Salary: 80,000-95,000

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Network Director of Nursing is a key clinical leader at CURE International, responsible for driving operational excellence, patient safety, and workforce development across our network of pediatric surgical hospitals. This role ensures that nursing services are standardized, data-informed, spiritually grounded, and responsive to the needs of children and families across diverse cultural and clinical settings.

Focused on six strategic domains (leadership; training and capacity building; patient safety and quality assurance; EMR utilization and data integrity; workforce planning and staffing; and patient flow optimization), the Director will drive system-wide nursing excellence. This leader will be an advocate for nurses, a steward of quality care, and a trusted partner to hospital and ministry leadership.

Why CURE?

Every year, thousands of children suffering from treatable disabilities receive life-changing surgery and compassionate care through our hospitals. As the Network Director of Nursing, you'll help shape the quality of care delivered across an entire network of hospitals, equipping nursing leaders, strengthening healthcare systems, and creating lasting impact for children and families around the world.

When you join CURE, you'll find:

  • A mission-driven organization where faith and healthcare come together to transform lives.
  • The opportunity to influence nursing practice across multiple countries.
  • Meaningful work alongside passionate healthcare professionals committed to excellence.
  • A collaborative leadership culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and servant leadership.
  • The chance to invest in the development of future nursing leaders while improving care for thousands of children each year.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic nursing leadership by mentoring and supporting nursing leaders across CURE's global hospital network while driving consistency, accountability, and clinical excellence.
  • Champion quality and patient safety by leading nursing best practices, standardizing care, and partnering with hospitals to improve clinical outcomes.
  • Develop and strengthen the nursing workforce through leadership coaching, competency development, mentorship programs, and succession planning.
  • Drive operational excellence by improving nursing workflows, supporting workforce planning, optimizing patient flow, and leveraging clinical data to enhance decision-making.
  • Collaborate across the organization with medical, quality, HR, IT, and hospital leadership teams to advance CURE's mission and strengthen healthcare delivery across the network.

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Nursing, Nursing Administration, or related field (MSN, MHA).

  • International leadership experience in cross-cultural or resource-limited healthcare settings required.

  • Operational and systems thinker with strong implementation ability.
  • Skilled at cross-cultural communication and navigating diverse healthcare contexts.
  • High emotional intelligence and demonstrated ability to lead change.
  • Strong understanding of clinical quality improvement, nursing informatics, and safety frameworks.

About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role
We are looking for a Principal Product Specialist for the Zero Trust Browser team to join our Product Management team. This is a remote role based in the UK, reporting to the Director, Product Management. You will provide technical leadership for Zscaler’s Zero Trust Browser solutions, owning product success throughout the sales lifecycle. You will serve as a thought leader for browser-layer security architecture and strategy while partnering with sales and engineering to drive technical wins and product enhancements for our Zero Trust Browser offerings.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)
  • Provide technical leadership for Zscaler’s Zero Trust Browser solutions, owning product success and architectural strategy throughout the sales lifecycle
  • Lead in-person and virtual meetings with customer executives and practitioners to provide executive-level overviews of Zscaler’s browser security strategy and deep-dive technical workshops
  • Articulate the value of browser-layer security controls, including threat monitoring, attack prevention, in-browser DLP, secure private application access, and Privileged Remote Access (PRA)
  • Develop technical collateral, including best practice guides, proof-of-value (POV) test plans, demo assets, and reference architectures to support internal teams and customer presentations
  • Conduct and support POVs, technical evaluations, and initial deployments, helping customers validate architecture, policy design, and operational fit for Zero Trust Browser use cases
  • Troubleshoot and debug customer issues across evaluations and deployments, partnering closely with Engineering, Support, and Customer Success teams to drive timely resolution
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, and Marketing to drive product enhancements based on direct customer feedback, competitive insights, and market trends
  • Act as a post-sales subject matter expert for Customer Success and Deployment teams to help ensure successful technical implementation, adoption, and ongoing customer success

Who You Are (Success Profile)
  • You thrive in ambiguity. You are comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running toward challenges because you are laser-focused on finding solutions, knowing that solving hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback, knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are committed to your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)
  • 7+ years of professional experience in product management, presales, product specialization, or professional services within the infrastructure technology or cybersecurity industry
  • Deep technical domain expertise in browser security, Zero Trust architecture, private application access, privileged access use cases, and modern web security controls
  • Strong understanding of Internet and security protocols, including HTTP, SSL/TLS, DNS, and secure access patterns for web and private applications
  • Proven track record of developing technical collateral and supporting go-to-market initiatives that drive successful sales outcomes
  • Exceptional interpersonal and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical practitioners and executive leadership
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Product Management, and customer-facing teams

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)
  • Deep Zscaler hands-on experience and product knowledge across Zero Trust Browser, ZIA, ZPA, Zscaler Client Connector, and Privileged Remote Access capabilities
  • Experience with browser extensions, browser-layer telemetry, in-browser DLP, and controls that secure user activity across SaaS, web, and private applications
  • Strong understanding of secure private application access and privileged resource access use cases in enterprise environments
  • Extensive experience in networking concepts and modern identity and access management (IAM) frameworks

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

About Artemetrx

Artemetrx is PSG’s healthcare analytics, technology, and advisory business, helping healthcare organizations transform complex healthcare data into actionable insights, strategic decisions, and measurable outcomes.

The business combines a sophisticated healthcare analytics platform with deep domain expertise to deliver technology-enabled solutions supported by experienced healthcare consultants, pharmacists, clinicians, and analytics professionals.

Artemetrx serves health plans, employers, labor organizations, government entities, consultants, and other healthcare stakeholders seeking to improve healthcare affordability, optimize pharmacy benefit performance, strengthen oversight, and achieve better health outcomes.

Opportunity

PSG is seeking an accomplished executive to lead Artemetrx through its next phase of growth and evolution.

Artemetrx is a successful and established business with a strong reputation, proven capabilities, loyal clients, and differentiated solutions. PSG believes there is significant untapped opportunity to further scale the business through continued investment in product innovation, commercialization, operational maturity, and market expansion.

The SVP & General Manager will build upon a strong foundation while shaping the future vision, strategy, and growth trajectory of the business. This role is ideal for a leader energized by scaling organizations, building high-performing teams, developing innovative market solutions, and creating long-term enterprise value.

The Advantage of the PSG & EPIC Ecosystem

Unlike many standalone healthcare technology companies, Artemetrx benefits from being part of the broader PSG and EPIC ecosystem. This creates a meaningful platform for accelerated growth, differentiated client value, and expanded market reach.

  • Deep healthcare and pharmacy expertise
  • Established client relationships and market credibility
  • Proven consulting and advisory capabilities
  • Strategic partnerships and industry relationships
  • Cross-selling and integrated solution development opportunities
  • A collaborative environment that combines technology, analytics, and consulting expertise

Position Summary

The SVP & General Manager will have full responsibility for the strategic direction, growth, financial performance, and overall success of Artemetrx.

The role requires a leader who can balance strategic vision with operational execution while driving growth across technology, analytics, and advisory services. The successful candidate will serve as the primary business leader for Artemetrx and a key contributor to PSG’s broader growth and innovation strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Business Strategy & Growth

  • Develop and execute the long-term strategy for Artemetrx.
  • Identify opportunities for growth, innovation, and market expansion.
  • Evaluate new products, services, partnerships, and strategic investments.
  • Drive sustainable revenue growth and long-term enterprise value creation.

Product, Technology & Innovation

  • Establish the strategic vision and roadmap for the Artemetrx platform.
  • Ensure product investments align with market needs and client priorities.
  • Advance data, analytics, technology, and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Maintain a differentiated value proposition that combines technology and expert advisory services.

Commercial Performance

  • Lead the commercial growth strategy for the business.
  • Partner with PSG leadership to drive market awareness, client acquisition, retention, and expansion.
  • Support strategic client relationships and key growth opportunities.
  • Strengthen market positioning and thought leadership.

Operations & Financial Performance

  • Maintain accountability for revenue, profitability, and operational performance.
  • Lead business planning, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Establish performance metrics and management disciplines that support scalable growth.
  • Drive operational excellence, efficiency, and execution.

Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Build and lead a high-performing leadership team.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and client focus.
  • Develop organizational capabilities required to support future growth.
  • Attract, retain, and develop exceptional talent.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience.
  • Significant experience leading healthcare technology, analytics, data, consulting, or technology-enabled services businesses.
  • Demonstrated success scaling organizations and driving sustainable growth.
  • Strong financial, operational, and business management capabilities.
  • Prior General Manager, Business Unit Leader, or equivalent P&L leadership responsibility.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and complex business operations.

Preferred

  • MBA or advanced healthcare-related degree.
  • Experience in healthcare analytics, healthcare technology, PBM, specialty pharmacy, health plan, consulting, or related industries.
  • Experience with SaaS and technology enabled advisory commercialization models.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to elevate Artemetrx from a successful healthcare analytics and advisory business into a scaled, market-leading healthcare technology and insights platform.

The successful candidate will accelerate growth, strengthen market position, expand product capabilities, enhance operational scalability, develop future leaders, and maximize the strategic value of Artemetrx within the broader PSG and EPIC ecosystem.

COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this position is $275,000 – $325,000. This range represents the employer’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this role at the time of posting.

Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, training, certifications, education, internal equity, and market data. This role may also be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package.

WHY EPIC

EPIC has over 60 offices and 4,000 employees nationwide – and we’re growing! It’s a great time to join the team and be a part of this growth. We offer:

  • Generous leave time options: Paid parental leave, pregnancy disability and bonding leave, and organ donor/bone marrow donor leave

  • Unique benefits such as Pet Insurance, Identity Theft & Fraud Protection Coverage, Legal Planning, Family Planning, and Menopause & Midlife Support
  • Additional benefits include (but are not limited to): 401(k) matching, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, and wellness & employee assistance programs
  • 50/50 Work Culture: EPIC fosters a 50/50 culture between producers and the rest of the business, supporting collaboration, teamwork, and an inclusive work environment. It takes both production and service to be EPIC!
  • EPIC Gives Back – Some of our charitable efforts include Donation Connection, Employee Assistance Fund, and People First Foundation
